```ts
const NUMBERING =
    `<w:numbering xmlns:w="${W}"><w:abstractNum w:abstractNumId="0"><w:lvl w:ilvl="0"><w:start w:val="1"/><w:numFmt w:val="decimal"/>` +
    `<w:lvlText w:val="%1."/></w:lvl></w:abstractNum><w:num w:numId="1"><w:abstractNumId w:val="0"/></w:num></w:numbering>`;
const glossary = (body = "") =>
    `<w:glossaryDocument xmlns:w="${W}" xmlns:r="${REL}"><w:docParts><w:docPart><w:docPartPr><w:name w:val="Part"/>` +
    `<w:category><w:name w:val="General"/><w:gallery w:val="placeholder"/></w:category><w:guid w:val="{6A9E2C40-3F1B-4C55-9D2E-7B1A0C9D4E11}"/></w:docPartPr>` +
    `<w:docPartBody><w:p><w:r><w:t>Part</w:t></w:r>${body}</w:p></w:docPartBody></w:docPart></w:docParts></w:glossaryDocument>`;
const GLOSSARY_TYPE = `${WML}.document.glossary+xml`;

/** The minimal package plus a reached glossary whose own relationships part relates `segment` -> `target` (`stored`). */
const glossaryRelating = (segment: string, target: string, stored: string, xml: string, override: string) =>
    buildDocx({
        ...P,
        "word/glossary/document.xml": glossary(),
        "word/glossary/_rels/document.xml.rels": relsPart(`<Relationship Id="rIdE" Type="${REL}/${segment}" Target="${target}"/>`),
        [stored]: xml,
        "word/_rels/document.xml.rels": rels(`<Relationship Id="rIdG" Type="${REL}/glossaryDocument" Target="glossary/document.xml"/>`),
        "[Content_Types].xml": ct(`<Override PartName="/word/glossary/document.xml" ContentType="${GLOSSARY_TYPE}"/>${override}`),
    });
const ov = (part: string, type: string) => `<Override PartName="/${part}" ContentType="${type}"/>`;

/** The main document with `r` declared, `run` added after the Hello run, and `sectPr` children prepended. */
const docWith = (run: string, sect = "") =>
    replaceOnce(
        replaceOnce(
            replaceOnce(DOC, `<w:document xmlns:w="${W}"`, `<w:document xmlns:w="${W}" xmlns:r="${REL}"`),
            "<w:t>Hello</w:t></w:r>",
            `<w:t>Hello</w:t></w:r>${run}`,
        ),
        "<w:sectPr>",
        `<w:sectPr>${sect}`,
    );
/** A part the main document relates (and uses, through `doc`), typed by an Override with `type`, or by the Default when `type` is undefined. */
const mainPart = (o: { segment: string; file: string; xml: string; type: string | undefined; doc?: string }) =>
    buildDocx({
        ...P,
        "word/document.xml": o.doc ?? DOC,
        [`word/${o.file}`]: o.xml,
        "word/_rels/document.xml.rels": rels(`<Relationship Id="rIdX" Type="${REL}/${o.segment}" Target="${o.file}"/>`),
        "[Content_Types].xml": o.type === undefined ? CT : ct(ov(`word/${o.file}`, o.type)),
    });
const USED = {
    numbering: { segment: "numbering", file: "numbering.xml", xml: NUMBERING, type: `${WML}.numbering+xml` },
    glossary: { segment: "glossaryDocument", file: "glossary/document.xml", xml: glossary(), type: GLOSSARY_TYPE },
    footer: {
        segment: "footer",
        file: "footer9.xml",
        xml: FOOTER,
        type: `${WML}.footer+xml`,
        doc: docWith("", `<w:footerReference w:type="default" r:id="rIdX"/>`),
    },
    footnotes: {
        segment: "footnotes",
        file: "footnotes.xml",
        xml: FOOTNOTES,
        type: `${WML}.footnotes+xml`,
        doc: docWith(`<w:r><w:footnoteReference w:id="1"/></w:r>`),
    },
    endnotes: {
        segment: "endnotes",
        file: "endnotes.xml",
        xml: ENDNOTES,
        type: `${WML}.endnotes+xml`,
        doc: docWith(`<w:r><w:endnoteReference w:id="1"/></w:r>`),
    },
    comments: {
        segment: "comments",
        file: "comments.xml",
        xml: COMMENTS,
        type: `${WML}.comments+xml`,
        doc: docWith(`<w:r><w:commentReference w:id="0"/></w:r>`),
    },
} as const;
type Used = keyof typeof USED;
const charset = (k: Used) => mainPart({ ...USED[k], type: USED[k].type + CHARSET });
const exact = (k: Used) => mainPart({ ...USED[k] });
const generic = (k: Used) => mainPart({ ...USED[k], type: undefined });

const HEADER = `<w:hdr xmlns:w="${W}"><w:p><w:r><w:t>Header</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:hdr>`;
const STYLES_TYPE = `${WML}.styles+xml`;
const GLOSSARY_STYLES = `<w:styles xmlns:w="${W}"></w:styles>`;
const padded = (k: Used) => mainPart({ ...USED[k], type: USED[k].type + " " });
/** The part related from the main document but not used: no reference, the main document unchanged. */
const unused = (segment: string, file: string, xml: string, type: string) => mainPart({ segment, file, xml, type: type + CHARSET });

const T = (segment: string) => `${WML}.${segment}+xml`;
const HEADER_REF = docWith("", `<w:headerReference w:type="default" r:id="rIdX"/>`);
/** A header the main document references from its sectPr, typed `type`. */
const mainHeader = (type: string) => mainPart({ segment: "header", file: "header9.xml", xml: HEADER, type, doc: HEADER_REF });
/** Session 23's glossary that references footer9.xml from its docPartBody's sectPr. */
const glossaryWithFooterRef = () =>
    `<w:glossaryDocument xmlns:w="${W}" xmlns:r="${REL}"><w:docParts><w:docPart><w:docPartPr><w:name w:val="Part"/>` +
    `<w:category><w:name w:val="General"/><w:gallery w:val="placeholder"/></w:category><w:guid w:val="{6A9E2C40-3F1B-4C55-9D2E-7B1A0C9D4E11}"/></w:docPartPr>` +
    `<w:docPartBody><w:p><w:r><w:t>Part</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:sectPr><w:footerReference w:type="default" r:id="rIdF"/></w:sectPr></w:docPartBody>` +
    `</w:docPart></w:docParts></w:glossaryDocument>`;
const footerViaGlossary = (type: string) =>
    buildDocx({
        ...P,
        "word/glossary/document.xml": glossaryWithFooterRef(),
        "word/glossary/_rels/document.xml.rels": relsPart(`<Relationship Id="rIdF" Type="${REL}/footer" Target="footer9.xml"/>`),
        "word/glossary/footer9.xml": FOOTER,
        "word/_rels/document.xml.rels": rels(`<Relationship Id="rIdG" Type="${REL}/glossaryDocument" Target="glossary/document.xml"/>`),
        "[Content_Types].xml": ct(
            `<Override PartName="/word/glossary/document.xml" ContentType="${GLOSSARY_TYPE}"/>${ov("word/glossary/footer9.xml", type)}`,
        ),
    });

/** S-A: the main document's `w:headerReference r:id="rIdX"` where rIdX is a footer-type relationship to a `w:hdr` part. */
const headerViaFooterRel = (type: string) => mainPart({ segment: "footer", file: "header9.xml", xml: HEADER, type, doc: HEADER_REF });
/** S-B: a footer read through rIdX (footer) that an unused header relationship rIdH also targets. */
const footerAlsoUnusedHeader = (type: string) =>
    buildDocx({
        ...P,
        "word/document.xml": USED.footer.doc,
        "word/footer9.xml": FOOTER,
        "word/_rels/document.xml.rels": rels(
            `<Relationship Id="rIdX" Type="${REL}/footer" Target="footer9.xml"/><Relationship Id="rIdH" Type="${REL}/header" Target="footer9.xml"/>`,
        ),
        "[Content_Types].xml": ct(ov("word/footer9.xml", type)),
    });
/** F3: a reached glossary that references header9.xml from its docPartBody's sectPr. */
const headerViaGlossary = (type: string) =>
    buildDocx({
        ...P,
        "word/glossary/document.xml": glossaryWithFooterRef().replace(
            `<w:footerReference w:type="default" r:id="rIdF"/>`,
            `<w:headerReference w:type="default" r:id="rIdF"/>`,
        ),
        "word/glossary/_rels/document.xml.rels": relsPart(`<Relationship Id="rIdF" Type="${REL}/header" Target="header9.xml"/>`),
        "word/glossary/header9.xml": HEADER,
        "word/_rels/document.xml.rels": rels(`<Relationship Id="rIdG" Type="${REL}/glossaryDocument" Target="glossary/document.xml"/>`),
        "[Content_Types].xml": ct(
            `<Override PartName="/word/glossary/document.xml" ContentType="${GLOSSARY_TYPE}"/>${ov("word/glossary/header9.xml", type)}`,
        ),
    });

const specimens: [string, string, () => Promise<Uint8Array> | Uint8Array][] = [
    ["s26a-control-minimal", "control", () => buildDocx(P)],
    ["headerref-footer-rel-typed-footer-exact", "S-A control", () => headerViaFooterRel(T("footer"))],
    ["headerref-footer-rel-typed-footer-charset", "S-A", () => headerViaFooterRel(T("footer") + CHARSET)],
    ["headerref-footer-rel-typed-header-exact", "S-A", () => headerViaFooterRel(T("header"))],
    ["footer-read-unused-header-rel-typed-header", "S-B", () => footerAlsoUnusedHeader(T("header"))],
    ["footer-read-unused-header-rel-typed-footer", "S-B control", () => footerAlsoUnusedHeader(T("footer"))],
    ["glossary-header-typed-footer-exact", "F3", () => headerViaGlossary(T("footer"))],
    ["s26a-control-minimal-end", "control", () => buildDocx(P)],
];
const only = new Set((process.env.ONLY ?? "").split(",").filter(Boolean));

const dir = process.env.BUILD_DIR;
if (!dir) throw new Error("BUILD_DIR is required");
mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
for (const [name, issue, make] of specimens) {
    if (only.size > 0 && !only.has(name)) continue;
    const bytes = await make();
    const file = `${name}.docx`;
    writeFileSync(path.join(dir, file), bytes);
    const sha256 = createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
    const verdict = async (profile: "word-valid" | "strict") => {
        const r = await validate(path.join(dir, file), { profile });
        return {
            valid: r.valid,
            errors: [...new Set(r.issues.filter((x) => x.severity === "error").map((x) => `${x.code}@${x.path ?? "-"}`))],
        };
    };
    const row = { name, issue, file, sha256, calibration: false, wordValid: await verdict("word-valid"), strict: await verdict("strict") };
    appendFileSync(path.join(dir, "..", "specimens.jsonl"), JSON.stringify(row) + "\n");
    console.log(
        `built ${file} ${sha256.slice(0, 16)} word-valid=${row.wordValid.valid} ${row.wordValid.errors.join(",")} strict=${row.strict.valid}`,
    );
}
```

Session 27's builder (`s27a`–`s27c`) is another standalone script, run the same way, with `CHUNK` naming the chunk:

```ts
// Session 27 (2026-10-24): the items adversarial review AZ (layer 129, #611) left for a Word probe, plus the
// placements layer 129's check judges without a session 26 observation.
// s27a: S1/S2 — a body headerReference naming a header relationship to a w:hdr part typed header+xml (the clean
//       session 26 shape, `headerref-header-rel-hdr-typed-header`) whose relationship Type is padded with spaces,
//       wrapped in tab/newline character references, upper-cased (`…/HEADER`), `http://example.com/header`, or
//       `…/relationships/custom/header`; S3 — the same clean shape plus a second Relationship with the same Id rIdX,
//       Type footer, listed last.
// s27b: S3 mirror — the session 26 refused shape (headerReference → footer relationship rIdX to a w:ftr part) plus a
//       second rIdX of Type header listed last; the refused shape with its reference moved into a paragraph-level
//       w:pPr/w:sectPr, or into the w:sectPr of a w:sectPrChange (with the clean shape moved there as its control: the
//       schema's CT_SectPrBase has no header reference at all); the clean shape with relationship Type "header" (no URI),
//       or the ISO Strict header relationship URI (http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/header).
// s27c: the footer side of s27a/s27b's URI results — a body footerReference naming a footer relationship to a w:ftr part
//       typed footer+xml whose Type is `http://example.com/footer`, `…/relationships/custom/footer`, `…/FOOTER`, or the
//       ISO Strict footer URI, with the unmodified shape as a control.
// Shapes: tests/support/story-content-type-specimens.ts at 9eb10acb (`storyReferenceParts`), as review AZ's probe-az.
// Run from a worktree root at 9eb10acb as a copy: BUILD_DIR=<chunk>/src CHUNK=s27a|s27b|s27c pnpm exec tsx s27builder.tmp.mts
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { appendFileSync, mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { MINIMAL_PARTS, buildDocx } from "./tests/support/minimal-docx";
import { STORY_FOOTER_XML, STORY_HEADER_XML, storyContentType, storyReferenceParts } from "./tests/support/story-content-type-specimens";
import { validate } from "./src/scripts/office/validate";

const R = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships";
type Parts = Record<string, string>;
const REF = `<w:headerReference w:type="default" r:id="rIdX"/>`;
const clean = (): Parts => storyReferenceParts("headerReference", "header", "header9.xml", STORY_HEADER_XML, storyContentType("header"));
const refused = (): Parts => storyReferenceParts("headerReference", "footer", "footer9.xml", STORY_FOOTER_XML, storyContentType("footer"));
const replaceOnce = (text: string, from: string, to: string) => {
    if (!text.includes(from)) throw new Error(`missing ${from}`);
    return text.replace(from, to);
};
const edit = (parts: Parts, file: string, from: string, to: string): Parts => ({ ...parts, [file]: replaceOnce(parts[file]!, from, to) });
const RELS = "word/_rels/document.xml.rels";
const DOC = "word/document.xml";
const retype = (type: string) => edit(clean(), RELS, `Type="${R}/header"`, `Type="${type}"`);
const control = () => buildDocx(MINIMAL_PARTS);
/** The body sectPr's reference moved into a w:sectPrChange, its last child (CT_SectPr), inside that change's w:sectPr. */
const inSectPrChange = (parts: Parts): Parts =>
    edit(
        edit(parts, DOC, REF, ""),
        DOC,
        "</w:sectPr></w:body>",
        `<w:sectPrChange w:id="1" w:author="A" w:date="2026-10-24T00:00:00Z"><w:sectPr>${REF}</w:sectPr></w:sectPrChange></w:sectPr></w:body>`,
    );

const cleanFooter = (): Parts =>
    storyReferenceParts("footerReference", "footer", "footer9.xml", STORY_FOOTER_XML, storyContentType("footer"));
const retypeFooter = (type: string) => edit(cleanFooter(), RELS, `Type="${R}/footer"`, `Type="${type}"`);

const chunks: Record<string, [string, string, () => Promise<Uint8Array> | Uint8Array][]> = {
    s27a: [
        ["s27a-control-minimal", "control", control],
        ["headerref-header-rel-type-padded", "AZ S1", () => buildDocx(retype(` ${R}/header `))],
        ["headerref-header-rel-type-tab-newline", "AZ S1", () => buildDocx(retype(`&#x9;${R}/header&#xA;`))],
        ["headerref-header-rel-type-upper", "AZ S2", () => buildDocx(retype(`${R}/HEADER`))],
        ["headerref-header-rel-type-example-com", "AZ S2", () => buildDocx(retype("http://example.com/header"))],
        ["headerref-header-rel-type-custom-header", "AZ S2", () => buildDocx(retype(`${R}/custom/header`))],
        [
            "headerref-duplicate-id-last-footer",
            "AZ S3",
            () =>
                buildDocx(
                    edit(
                        clean(),
                        RELS,
                        "</Relationships>",
                        `<Relationship Id="rIdX" Type="${R}/footer" Target="header9.xml"/></Relationships>`,
                    ),
                ),
        ],
        ["s27a-control-minimal-end", "control", control],
    ],
    s27b: [
        ["s27b-control-minimal", "control", control],
        [
            "headerref-duplicate-id-last-header",
            "AZ S3 mirror",
            () =>
                buildDocx(
                    edit(
                        refused(),
                        RELS,
                        "</Relationships>",
                        `<Relationship Id="rIdX" Type="${R}/header" Target="footer9.xml"/></Relationships>`,
                    ),
                ),
        ],
        [
            "headerref-footer-rel-paragraph-sectpr",
            "placement",
            () => {
                const p = edit(refused(), DOC, REF, "");
                return buildDocx(edit(p, DOC, "<w:r>", `<w:pPr><w:sectPr>${REF}</w:sectPr></w:pPr><w:r>`));
            },
        ],
        ["headerref-footer-rel-in-sectprchange", "placement", () => buildDocx(inSectPrChange(refused()))],
        ["headerref-header-rel-in-sectprchange", "placement control", () => buildDocx(inSectPrChange(clean()))],
        ["headerref-header-rel-type-bare", "AZ S2", () => buildDocx(retype("header"))],
        [
            "headerref-header-rel-type-strict-uri",
            "AZ S2",
            () => buildDocx(retype("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/header")),
        ],
        ["s27b-control-minimal-end", "control", control],
    ],
    s27c: [
        ["s27c-control-minimal", "control", control],
        ["footerref-footer-rel-type-example-com", "AZ S2 footer", () => buildDocx(retypeFooter("http://example.com/footer"))],
        ["footerref-footer-rel-type-custom-footer", "AZ S2 footer", () => buildDocx(retypeFooter(`${R}/custom/footer`))],
        ["footerref-footer-rel-type-upper", "AZ S2 footer", () => buildDocx(retypeFooter(`${R}/FOOTER`))],
        [
            "footerref-footer-rel-type-strict-uri",
            "AZ S2 footer",
            () => buildDocx(retypeFooter("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/footer")),
        ],
        ["footerref-footer-rel-ftr-typed-footer", "control (session 26 clean footer shape)", () => buildDocx(cleanFooter())],
        ["s27c-control-minimal-end", "control", control],
    ],
};

const chunk = process.env.CHUNK ?? "";
const specimens = chunks[chunk];
if (!specimens) throw new Error(`CHUNK must be one of ${Object.keys(chunks).join(", ")}`);
const dir = process.env.BUILD_DIR;
if (!dir) throw new Error("BUILD_DIR is required");
mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
for (const [name, issue, make] of specimens) {
    const bytes = await make();
    const file = `${name}.docx`;
    writeFileSync(path.join(dir, file), bytes);
    const sha256 = createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
    const verdict = async (profile: "word-valid" | "strict") => {
        const r = await validate(path.join(dir, file), { profile });
        return {
            valid: r.valid,
            errors: [...new Set(r.issues.filter((x) => x.severity === "error").map((x) => `${x.code}@${x.path ?? "-"}`))],
        };
    };
    const row = { name, issue, file, sha256, calibration: false, wordValid: await verdict("word-valid"), strict: await verdict("strict") };
    appendFileSync(path.join(dir, "..", "specimens.jsonl"), JSON.stringify(row) + "\n");
    console.log(
        `built ${file} ${sha256.slice(0, 16)} word-valid=${row.wordValid.valid} ${row.wordValid.errors.join(",")} strict=${row.strict.valid}`,
    );
}
```

```ts
// Session 28 (2026-10-24): does Word read a w:hyperlink's relationship Type exactly, as session 27 found for header and
// footer references (#613)? `word-hyperlink-relationship` (src/scripts/office/checks/word-hyperlink.ts) accepts any
// Type that ends in /hyperlink with TargetMode External.
// s28a: `MINIMAL_PARTS` with a body w:hyperlink r:id="rIdH" naming an External relationship to https://example.org/
//       whose Type is the Transitional hyperlink URI (control), the ISO Strict hyperlink URI,
```

```ts
//       .rels removed, or kept without an rId9, each stored as .xml (calibration) and as .bin.
// Shapes: tests/support/minimal-docx.ts and review BD's report.
// Run from a worktree root as a copy: BUILD_DIR=<chunk>/src CHUNK=s32a pnpm exec tsx s32builder.tmp.mts
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { appendFileSync, mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { MINIMAL_PARTS, buildDocx } from "./tests/support/minimal-docx";
import { validate } from "./src/scripts/office/validate";

const R = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships";
type Parts = Record<string, string>;
const replaceOnce = (text: string, from: string, to: string) => {
    if (!text.includes(from)) throw new Error(`missing ${from}`);
    return text.replace(from, to);
};
const CT = "[Content_Types].xml";
const MAIN = "word/document.xml";
const RELS = "word/_rels/document.xml.rels";
/** Rename the main document to word/document.bin, with its sidecar (when present), Override and package relationship. */
const toBin = (parts: Parts): Parts => {
    const out: Parts = { ...parts };
    out["word/document.bin"] = out[MAIN]!;
    delete out[MAIN];
    if (out[RELS] !== undefined) {
        out["word/_rels/document.bin.rels"] = out[RELS]!;
        delete out[RELS];
    }
    out[CT] = replaceOnce(out[CT]!, 'PartName="/word/document.xml"', 'PartName="/word/document.bin"');
    out["_rels/.rels"] = replaceOnce(out["_rels/.rels"]!, 'Target="word/document.xml"', 'Target="word/document.bin"');
    return out;
};
const truncated = (): Parts => ({ ...(MINIMAL_PARTS as Parts), [MAIN]: replaceOnce(MINIMAL_PARTS[MAIN]!, "</w:body></w:document>", "") });
/** The main document's sectPr references footer rId9; `sidecar: false` removes its .rels, otherwise the .rels has no rId9. */
const footerRef = (sidecar: boolean): Parts => {
    const parts: Parts = { ...(MINIMAL_PARTS as Parts) };
    parts[MAIN] = replaceOnce(
        replaceOnce(parts[MAIN]!, "<w:document ", `<w:document xmlns:r="${R}" `),
        "<w:sectPr>",
        '<w:sectPr><w:footerReference w:type="default" r:id="rId9"/>',
    );
    if (!sidecar) delete parts[RELS];
    return parts;
};
const control = () => buildDocx(MINIMAL_PARTS);

const chunks: Record<string, [string, string, () => Promise<Uint8Array> | Uint8Array][]> = {
    s32a: [
        ["s32a-control-minimal", "control", control],
        ["main-truncated", "calibration (.xml twin of review BD S1)", () => buildDocx(truncated())],
        ["bin-main-truncated", "review BD S1", () => buildDocx(toBin(truncated()))],
        ["footerref-rid-no-sidecar", "calibration (.xml twin of review BD S2)", () => buildDocx(footerRef(false))],
        ["bin-footerref-rid-no-sidecar", "review BD S2", () => buildDocx(toBin(footerRef(false)))],
        ["footerref-rid-missing", "calibration (.xml twin of review BD S2)", () => buildDocx(footerRef(true))],
        ["bin-footerref-rid-missing", "review BD S2", () => buildDocx(toBin(footerRef(true)))],
        ["s32a-control-minimal-end", "control", control],
    ],
};

const chunk = process.env.CHUNK ?? "";
const specimens = chunks[chunk];
if (!specimens) throw new Error(`CHUNK must be one of ${Object.keys(chunks).join(", ")}`);
const dir = process.env.BUILD_DIR;
if (!dir) throw new Error("BUILD_DIR is required");
mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
for (const [name, issue, make] of specimens) {
    const bytes = await make();
    const file = `${name}.docx`;
    writeFileSync(path.join(dir, file), bytes);
    const sha256 = createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
    const verdict = async (profile: "word-valid" | "strict") => {
        const r = await validate(path.join(dir, file), { profile });
        return {
            valid: r.valid,
            errors: [...new Set(r.issues.filter((x) => x.severity === "error").map((x) => `${x.code}@${x.path ?? "-"}`))],
        };
    };
    const row = { name, issue, file, sha256, calibration: false, wordValid: await verdict("word-valid"), strict: await verdict("strict") };
    appendFileSync(path.join(dir, "..", "specimens.jsonl"), JSON.stringify(row) + "\n");
    console.log(
        `built ${file} ${sha256.slice(0, 16)} word-valid=${row.wordValid.valid} ${row.wordValid.errors.join(",")} strict=${row.strict.valid} ${row.strict.errors.join(",")}`,
    );
}
```

```ts
// Session 34 (2026-10-25): adversarial review of #632's fix (45abe57e, layer 131) by empryo devin/swe-2, findings 1, 2
// and 4. Before that fix a raw mc:AlternateContent child of a .rels part was a blocking opc-relationships-structure
// error; after it, readers that still read the stored .rels (word-read-parts' relationshipsOf/packageReach,
// properties-parts, validateAllRelationshipIds) miss a relationship that markup compatibility selects, so a defect
// reached only through it is demoted under word-valid. Each wrapped specimen moves one relationship into
// <mc:AlternateContent><mc:Choice Requires="foo"/><mc:Fallback>…</mc:Fallback></mc:AlternateContent> (Word follows it:
// s33d/s33e) and carries a defect Word refuses when the relationship is direct; its direct twin runs beside it.
// s34a: C, a malformed main document reached through the Fallback officeDocument relationship; D, a zero-byte
//       word/_rels/document.xml.rels beside that main document; E, _rels/.rels holding a direct rId1 (officeDocument)
//       and a Fallback rId1 (styles), a duplicate Id only in the processed view; each with its direct twin.
// s34b: F, a malformed docProps/core.xml reached through a Fallback core-properties relationship; H, session 26's
//       footer typed as a header (#600) with its relationship in the Fallback; each with its direct twin; I,
//       mc:MustUnderstand="foo" on the _rels/.rels root (review finding 4); L, the footer relationship in an mc:Choice
//       whose Requires prefix is undeclared, Fallback empty (an mce-malformed AlternateContent; review finding 4).
// s34c/s34d: I and L each alone beside a control, after Word crashed during s34b.
// Shapes: reviews/review-632 probe.mts and controls.mts; tests/support/{minimal-docx,story-content-type-specimens,
// relationships-markup-compatibility-specimens}.ts at layer 131.
// Run from the layer 131 worktree root as a copy: BUILD_DIR=<chunk>/src CHUNK=s34a pnpm exec tsx s34builder.tmp.mts
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { appendFileSync, mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { MINIMAL_PARTS, buildDocx } from "./tests/support/minimal-docx";
import { STORY_FOOTER_XML, storyContentType, storyReferenceParts } from "./tests/support/story-content-type-specimens";
import {
    DOCUMENT_RELS,
    MCE_DECLARATIONS,
    PACKAGE_RELS,
    fallback,
    wrapRelationship,
} from "./tests/support/relationships-markup-compatibility-specimens";
import { validate } from "./src/scripts/office/validate";

const R = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships";
const MC = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006";
const CT_CORE = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.core-properties+xml";
type Parts = Record<string, string>;
const MALFORMED_MAIN = `<?xml version="1.0"?><w:document xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"><w:body><w:p>`;
const MALFORMED_CORE = `<?xml version="1.0"?><cp:coreProperties xmlns:cp="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/metadata/core-properties"><dc:title xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/">broken`;

const chunk = process.env.CHUNK ?? "";

if (!specimens) throw new Error(`CHUNK must be one of ${Object.keys(chunks).join(", ")}`);
const dir = process.env.BUILD_DIR;

for (const [name, issue, make] of specimens) {
    const bytes = await make();
    const file = `${name}.docx`;
    writeFileSync(path.join(dir, file), bytes);
    const sha256 = createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
    const verdict = async (profile: "word-valid" | "strict") => {
        const r = await validate(path.join(dir, file), { profile });
        return {
            valid: r.valid,
            errors: [...new Set(r.issues.filter((x) => x.severity === "error").map((x) => `${x.code}@${x.path ?? "-"}`))],
        };
    };
    const row = { name, issue, file, sha256, calibration: false, wordValid: await verdict("word-valid"), strict: await verdict("strict") };
    appendFileSync(path.join(dir, "..", "specimens.jsonl"), JSON.stringify(row) + "\n");
    console.log(
        `built ${file} ${sha256.slice(0, 16)} word-valid=${row.wordValid.valid} ${row.wordValid.errors.join(",")} strict=${row.strict.valid} ${row.strict.errors.join(",")}`,
    );
}
```

```ts
//       with no Choice, and a foreign child of mc:AlternateContent), each keeping the styles relationship. Then #638's
//       boundary: a chart part with c:externalData r:id and no .rels, related by a chart relationship, stored outside word/
//       and under it.

//       proven finding P1 (#640): a _rels/.rels whose root is an mc:AlternateContent with the whole Relationships
//       element in its Fallback (S3), or with two bare Relationship elements there (#640: processing leaves two roots);
//       session 26's footer relationship inside an ignorable x:Wrap that mc:ProcessContent names (S2) and inside one it
//       does not (S2's mirror, where markup compatibility drops the relationship); and an rId2 in both an understood

//       bytes).

//       related but referenced by nothing), with no chart sidecar while c:externalData names rId1, in word/ and outside
//       it, and with no c:externalData (the drawing's own control); and the s36a malformed AlternateContent sibling in
//       the sidecar of a Word-read non-story part (styles) and of a story part (footer).

//       malformed sibling, and with mc:MustUnderstand, in its own sidecar word/_rels/doc2.xml.rels; mc:MustUnderstand

import { appendFileSync, mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";

const chunk = process.env.CHUNK ?? "";
const specimens = chunks[chunk];
if (!specimens) throw new Error(`CHUNK must be one of ${Object.keys(chunks).join(", ")}`);
const dir = process.env.BUILD_DIR;
if (!dir) throw new Error("BUILD_DIR is required");
mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
for (const [name, issue, make] of specimens) {
    const bytes = await make();
    const file = `${name}.docx`;
    writeFileSync(path.join(dir, file), bytes);
    const sha256 = createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
    const verdict = async (profile: "word-valid" | "strict") => {
        // #640: validate() throws on some shapes at the built commit; record the throw instead of stopping.
        try {
            const r = await validate(path.join(dir, file), { profile });
            return {
                valid: r.valid,
                errors: [...new Set(r.issues.filter((x) => x.severity === "error").map((x) => `${x.code}@${x.path ?? "-"}`))],
            };
        } catch (error) {
            return { valid: null, errors: [`threw:${(error as Error).name}:${(error as Error).message.slice(0, 80)}`] };
        }
    };
    const row = { name, issue, file, sha256, calibration: false, wordValid: await verdict("word-valid"), strict: await verdict("strict") };
    appendFileSync(path.join(dir, "..", "specimens.jsonl"), JSON.stringify(row) + "\n");
    console.log(
        `built ${file} ${sha256.slice(0, 16)} word-valid=${row.wordValid.valid} ${row.wordValid.errors.join(",")} strict=${row.strict.valid} ${row.strict.errors.join(",")}`,
    );
}
```

```ts
// Session 37 (2026-10-25): the relationships parts #644 leaves unobserved. s36d showed the malformed AlternateContent
// sibling opening clean in the styles and footer sidecars; #644 extends that warning to every other sidecar that is
// not a story root's. s37a shows Word the same sibling in the sidecars of settings, numbering and a header, beside a
// control holding settings and numbering without sidecars, and mc:MustUnderstand on the root of the styles and footer
// sidecars (s36e observed it only on story-root and stray sidecars).
// Run from the layer 131 worktree root as a copy: BUILD_DIR=<chunk>/src CHUNK=s37a pnpm exec tsx s37builder.tmp.mts
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { appendFileSync, mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { MINIMAL_PARTS, buildDocx } from "./tests/support/minimal-docx";
import {
    STORY_FOOTER_XML,
    STORY_HEADER_XML,
    glossaryStoryReferenceParts,
    storyContentType,
    storyReferenceParts,
} from "./tests/support/story-content-type-specimens";
import { MCE_DECLARATIONS, wrapRelationship } from "./tests/support/relationships-markup-compatibility-specimens";
import { validate } from "./src/scripts/office/validate";

const MC = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006";
const R = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships";
const C = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/chart";
const CT = "[Content_Types].xml";
const PACKAGE_RELS = "_rels/.rels";
const SIDECAR = "word/_rels/document.xml.rels";
const GLOSSARY_SIDECAR = "word/glossary/_rels/document.xml.rels";
type Parts = Record<string, string>;
const replaceOnce = (text: string, from: string | RegExp, to: string) => {
    if (typeof from === "string" ? !text.includes(from) : !from.test(text)) throw new Error(`missing ${from}`);
    return text.replace(from, to);
};
// The undeclared-Requires AlternateContent, as a sibling: it selects nothing and removes no relationship.
const MALFORMED_SIBLING = '<mc:AlternateContent><mc:Choice Requires="nope"/><mc:Fallback/></mc:AlternateContent></Relationships>';
const withSibling = (rels: string): string =>
    replaceOnce(replaceOnce(rels, "<Relationships ", `<Relationships xmlns:mc="${MC}" `), "</Relationships>", MALFORMED_SIBLING);
const STYLES_REL = /<Relationship Id="rId1"[^>]*\/>/;
const STYLES_REL_XML = `<Relationship Id="rId1" Type="${R}/styles" Target="styles.xml"/>`;
const chart = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n<c:chartSpace xmlns:c="${C}" xmlns:r="${R}"><c:chart><c:plotArea><c:layout/></c:plotArea></c:chart><c:externalData r:id="rId1"/></c:chartSpace>`;
const chartParts = (part: string, target: string): Parts => ({
    ...MINIMAL_PARTS,
    [part]: chart,
    [SIDECAR]: replaceOnce(
        MINIMAL_PARTS[SIDECAR]!,
        "</Relationships>",
        `<Relationship Id="rId9" Type="${R}/chart" Target="${target}"/></Relationships>`,
    ),
    [CT]: replaceOnce(
        MINIMAL_PARTS[CT]!,
        "</Types>",
        `<Override PartName="/${part}" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.drawingml.chart+xml"/></Types>`,
    ),
});
const control = () => buildDocx({ ...MINIMAL_PARTS });
const PR = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships";
const XML_DECLARATION = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n';
const OFFICE_REL = `<Relationship Id="rId1" Type="${R}/officeDocument" Target="word/document.xml"/>`;
const footer = () => storyReferenceParts("footerReference", "footer", "footer1.xml", STORY_FOOTER_XML, storyContentType("footer")) as Parts;
const WP = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/wordprocessingDrawing";
const A = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main";
const BAR_PLOT_AREA =
    '<c:plotArea><c:layout/><c:barChart><c:barDir val="col"/><c:grouping val="clustered"/><c:ser><c:idx val="0"/><c:order val="0"/>' +
    '<c:val><c:numLit><c:ptCount val="1"/><c:pt idx="0"><c:v>1</c:v></c:pt></c:numLit></c:val></c:ser><c:axId val="1"/><c:axId val="2"/></c:barChart>' +
    '<c:catAx><c:axId val="1"/><c:scaling><c:orientation val="minMax"/></c:scaling><c:delete val="0"/><c:axPos val="b"/><c:crossAx val="2"/></c:catAx>' +
    '<c:valAx><c:axId val="2"/><c:scaling><c:orientation val="minMax"/></c:scaling><c:delete val="0"/><c:axPos val="l"/><c:crossAx val="1"/></c:valAx></c:plotArea>';
const barChart = (externalData: boolean) =>
    `${XML_DECLARATION}<c:chartSpace xmlns:c="${C}" xmlns:a="${A}" xmlns:r="${R}"><c:chart>${BAR_PLOT_AREA}</c:chart>${externalData ? '<c:externalData r:id="rId1"/>' : ""}</c:chartSpace>`;
const CHART_DRAWING =
    '<w:p w14:paraId="00000002" w14:textId="00000002"><w:r><w:drawing><wp:inline distT="0" distB="0" distL="0" distR="0"><wp:extent cx="5486400" cy="3200400"/>' +
    '<wp:effectExtent l="0" t="0" r="0" b="0"/><wp:docPr id="1" name="Chart 1"/><wp:cNvGraphicFramePr/><a:graphic><a:graphicData uri="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/chart">' +
    '<c:chart r:id="rId9"/></a:graphicData></a:graphic></wp:inline></w:drawing></w:r></w:p>';
const referencedChartParts = (part: string, target: string, externalData: boolean): Parts => ({
    ...chartParts(part, target),
    [part]: barChart(externalData),
    "word/document.xml": replaceOnce(
        replaceOnce(
            MINIMAL_PARTS["word/document.xml"]!,
            "<w:document ",
            `<w:document xmlns:wp="${WP}" xmlns:a="${A}" xmlns:c="${C}" xmlns:r="${R}" `,
        ),
        "<w:sectPr>",
        `${CHART_DRAWING}<w:sectPr>`,
    ),
});
const MUST_UNDERSTAND_ROOT = (rels: string) =>
    replaceOnce(rels, "<Relationships ", `<Relationships xmlns:mc="${MC}" xmlns:foo="urn:foo" mc:MustUnderstand="foo" `);
const renamedMain = (sidecar: (rels: string) => string, stray?: (rels: string) => string): Parts => {
    const parts: Parts = {
        ...MINIMAL_PARTS,
        [PACKAGE_RELS]: replaceOnce(MINIMAL_PARTS[PACKAGE_RELS]!, 'Target="word/document.xml"', 'Target="word/doc2.xml"'),
        [CT]: replaceOnce(MINIMAL_PARTS[CT]!, 'PartName="/word/document.xml"', 'PartName="/word/doc2.xml"'),
        "word/doc2.xml": MINIMAL_PARTS["word/document.xml"]!,
        "word/_rels/doc2.xml.rels": sidecar(MINIMAL_PARTS[SIDECAR]!),
    };
    delete parts["word/document.xml"];
    delete parts[SIDECAR];
    if (stray) {
        parts["word/document.xml"] = MINIMAL_PARTS["word/document.xml"]!;
        parts[SIDECAR] = stray(MINIMAL_PARTS[SIDECAR]!);
    }
    return parts;
};
const EMPTY_RELS = `${XML_DECLARATION}<Relationships xmlns="${PR}"></Relationships>`;
const wrapFooter = (declarations: string) => wrapRelationship(footer(), SIDECAR, "rIdX", (rel) => `<x:Wrap>${rel}</x:Wrap>`, declarations);

const W = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main";
const withWordPart = (parts: Parts, file: string, type: string, ct: string, xml: string, id: string): Parts => ({
    ...parts,
    [`word/${file}`]: xml,
    [SIDECAR]: replaceOnce(
        parts[SIDECAR]!,
        "</Relationships>",
        `<Relationship Id="${id}" Type="${R}/${type}" Target="${file}"/></Relationships>`,
    ),
    [CT]: replaceOnce(
        parts[CT]!,
        "</Types>",
        `<Override PartName="/word/${file}" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.${ct}+xml"/></Types>`,
    ),
});
const withSettings = (parts: Parts): Parts =>
    withWordPart(parts, "settings.xml", "settings", "settings", `${XML_DECLARATION}<w:settings xmlns:w="${W}"/>`, "rId7");
const withNumbering = (parts: Parts): Parts =>
    withWordPart(parts, "numbering.xml", "numbering", "numbering", `${XML_DECLARATION}<w:numbering xmlns:w="${W}"/>`, "rId8");
const header = () => storyReferenceParts("headerReference", "header", "header1.xml", STORY_HEADER_XML, storyContentType("header")) as Parts;

// s37b (#645): a chart drawing inside an mc:AlternateContent, selected (Requires="w14", understood) or not
// (Requires="foo", unknown, empty Fallback), and a chart outside word/ reached by a chart and an image relationship.
const CHART_INSIDE = "word/charts/chart1.xml";
const CHART_OUTSIDE = "charts/chart1.xml";
const choiceWrappedChart = (requires: string, externalData: boolean): Parts => {
    const parts = referencedChartParts(CHART_INSIDE, "charts/chart1.xml", externalData);
    const main =
        requires === "foo"
            ? replaceOnce(parts["word/document.xml"]!, "<w:document ", '<w:document xmlns:foo="urn:foo" ')
            : parts["word/document.xml"]!;
    return {
        ...parts,
        "word/document.xml": replaceOnce(
            main,
            CHART_DRAWING,
            `<mc:AlternateContent><mc:Choice Requires="${requires}">${CHART_DRAWING}</mc:Choice><mc:Fallback/></mc:AlternateContent>`,
        ),
    };
};
const mixedReachChart = (): Parts => {
    const parts = chartParts(CHART_OUTSIDE, `../${CHART_OUTSIDE}`);
    return {
        ...parts,
        [SIDECAR]: replaceOnce(
            parts[SIDECAR]!,
            "</Relationships>",
            `<Relationship Id="rId8" Type="${R}/image" Target="../${CHART_OUTSIDE}"/></Relationships>`,
        ),
```

```ts
};
const rel = (id: string, type: string, target: string) => `<Relationship Id="${id}" Type="${R}/${type}" Target="${target}"/>`;
const rels = (body: string) => `${XML_DECLARATION}<Relationships xmlns="${PR}">${body}</Relationships>`;

// A chart related from a reached story's sidecar as rId9; `referenced` puts CHART_DRAWING before the story's first paragraph.
const storyChart = (source: "header" | "footnote" | "glossary", referenced: boolean) => {
    let p: Record<string, string>, part: string, side: string;
    if (source === "header") {
        p = storyContentTypeParts("header", storyContentType("header"));
        part = "word/header9.xml";
        side = "word/_rels/header9.xml.rels";
    } else {
        p = glossaryStoryParts("footnotes", true, true);
        part = source === "glossary" ? "word/glossary/document.xml" : "word/glossary/footnotes.xml";
        side = source === "glossary" ? "word/glossary/_rels/document.xml.rels" : "word/glossary/_rels/footnotes.xml.rels";
    }
    p[CH] = barChartXml(true);
    p[CT] = replaceOnce(p[CT]!, "</Types>", `<Override PartName="/${CH}" ContentType="${CHART_CONTENT_TYPE}"/></Types>`);
    p[side] = replaceOnce(
        p[side] ?? rels(""),
        "</Relationships>",
        rel("rId9", "chart", source === "header" ? "charts/chart1.xml" : "../charts/chart1.xml") + "</Relationships>",
    );
    if (referenced) {
        let xml = replaceOnce(
            p[part]!,
            /(<w:\w+)(\s)/,
            `$1 xmlns:w14="${W14}" xmlns:wp="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/wordprocessingDrawing" xmlns:a="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" xmlns:c="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/chart"$2`,
        );
        xml = xml.replaceAll(` xmlns:r="${R}"`, "");
        xml = replaceOnce(xml, /(<w:\w+)/, `$1 xmlns:r="${R}"`);
        p[part] = replaceOnce(xml, "<w:p>", CHART_DRAWING + "<w:p>");
    }
    return buildDocx(p);
};
// The main document's drawing behind an mc:Fallback: `selected` puts an unselected Choice before it.
const fallbackChart = (selected: boolean) => {
    const p = referencedChartSpecimenParts(CH, "charts/chart1.xml", true);
    p[MAIN] = replaceOnce(
        replaceOnce(
            p[MAIN]!,
            CHART_DRAWING,
            `<mc:AlternateContent><mc:Choice Requires="${selected ? "foo" : "w14"}"/><mc:Fallback>${CHART_DRAWING}</mc:Fallback></mc:AlternateContent>`,
        ),
        "<w:document ",
        '<w:document xmlns:foo="urn:foo" ',
    );
    return buildDocx(p);
};
// A second chart relationship rId8 to the same part.
const twoRelationships = (referenced: boolean) => {
    const p = referenced ? referencedChartSpecimenParts(CH, "charts/chart1.xml", true) : chartSpecimenParts(CH, "charts/chart1.xml");
    p[DR] = replaceOnce(p[DR]!, "</Relationships>", rel("rId8", "chart", "charts/chart1.xml") + "</Relationships>");

};
// The relationship targets an OPC-equivalent spelling of the stored chart name.
const equivalentTarget = (referenced: boolean) => {
    const p = referenced ? referencedChartSpecimenParts(CH, "charts/chart1.xml", true) : chartSpecimenParts(CH, "charts/chart1.xml");
    p[DR] = replaceOnce(p[DR]!, 'Target="charts/chart1.xml"', 'Target="CHARTS/%63hart1.xml"');
    return buildDocx(p);
};

const DECL = `xmlns:mc="${MC}" xmlns:foo="urn:foo" xmlns:w14="${W14}"`;
// The package part's own Relationships element, without its XML declaration.
const PLAIN = replaceOnce(MINIMAL_PARTS[PK]!, XML_DECLARATION, "");
const wrap = (xml: string) =>
    `<mc:AlternateContent ${DECL}><mc:Choice Requires="foo"/><mc:Fallback>${xml}</mc:Fallback></mc:AlternateContent>`;
const packageRoot = (root: string) => buildDocx({ ...MINIMAL_PARTS, [PK]: `${XML_DECLARATION}${root}` });
const control = () => buildDocx({ ...MINIMAL_PARTS });

const chunks: Record<string, Array<[string, string, () => Promise<Uint8Array>]>> = {
    s39a: [
        ["s39a-control-minimal", "control", control],
        [
            "chart-header-unreferenced",
            "#661: chart related from a referenced header's sidecar, Id unused",
            () => storyChart("header", false),
        ],
        [
            "chart-footnote-unreferenced",
            "#661: chart related from a reached glossary's footnotes sidecar, Id unused",
            () => storyChart("footnote", false),
        ],
        [
            "chart-glossary-unreferenced",
            "#661: chart related from a reached glossary document's sidecar, Id unused",
            () => storyChart("glossary", false),
        ],
        [
            "chart-unselected-fallback",
            "#661: the drawing only in an unselected mc:Fallback (selected empty w14 Choice)",
            () => fallbackChart(false),
        ],
        [
            "chart-two-relationships-no-references",
            "#661: two chart relationships to one part, neither Id used",
            () => twoRelationships(false),
        ],
        [
            "chart-equivalent-target-unreferenced",
            "#661: relationship targets CHARTS/%63hart1.xml, Id unused",
            () => equivalentTarget(false),
        ],
        ["s39a-control-minimal-end", "control", control],
    ],
    s39b: [
        ["s39b-control-minimal", "control", control],
        [

            "#662: Fallback holds a second wrapper whose Fallback holds Relationships",
            () => packageRoot(wrap(wrap(PLAIN))),
        ],
        ["package-root-three-nested-fallback", "#662: three nested Fallback wrappers", () => packageRoot(wrap(wrap(wrap(PLAIN))))],
        [
            "package-root-multiple-choices",

            () =>
                packageRoot(
                    `<mc:AlternateContent ${DECL}><mc:Choice Requires="foo"/><mc:Choice Requires="w14">${PLAIN}</mc:Choice><mc:Fallback/></mc:AlternateContent>`,
                ),
        ],
        [
            "package-root-first-of-two-understood-choices",
            "#662: two w14 Choices, the first holding Relationships, the second a foreign element",
            () =>
                packageRoot(
                    `<mc:AlternateContent ${DECL}><mc:Choice Requires="w14">${PLAIN}</mc:Choice><mc:Choice Requires="w14"><foo:bad/></mc:Choice><mc:Fallback/></mc:AlternateContent>`,
                ),

        ],

        ],
        ["s39b-control-minimal-end", "control", control],

    s39c: [

        ["chart-footnote-referenced", "#661 twin: the glossary footnotes' drawing names the chart", () => storyChart("footnote", true)],
        ["chart-glossary-referenced", "#661 twin: the glossary document's drawing names the chart", () => storyChart("glossary", true)],
        ["chart-selected-fallback", "#661 twin: the drawing in a selected mc:Fallback (unselected foo Choice)", () => fallbackChart(true)],
        [

};
```

Session 40's builder (`s40a`, `s40b`) is another standalone script, run the same way from the layer 135 worktree, with `CHUNK` naming the chunk:

```ts
// Session 40 (2026-10-25): the Word evidence #653 and #665 ask for before their fixes change a verdict or an output
// Word could see. #653: repairMissingParaIds now declares w14 on the stamped part's root and lists it in mc:Ignorable;
// s40a shows Word the repaired bytes the fix writes (taken from the real repair, not rebuilt) and release's shape, with
// xmlns:w14 on each stamped element and no Ignorable entry. #665: the file-reference walk no longer resolves a
// TargetMode="External" target as a part under strict and word-valid. Word-valid changes only for External targets
// the rels-broken blocking predicate keeps (`.rels`, `/_rels/`, `../customXml/`), so s40a/s40b show Word those, as a
// direct child and inside a selected w14 Choice, plus one a w:hyperlink names and one `file:///…pdf` reference.
// Run from the layer 135 worktree root as a copy: BUILD_DIR=<chunk>/src CHUNK=s40a pnpm exec tsx s40builder.tmp.mts
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { appendFileSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, readdirSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { NS } from "./src/lib/types";
import { validate } from "./src/scripts/office/validate";
import { DOCXSchemaValidator } from "./src/scripts/office/validators/docx";
import { MINIMAL_PARTS, buildDocx } from "./tests/support/minimal-docx";
import { DOCUMENT_RELS, MCE_DECLARATIONS } from "./tests/support/relationships-markup-compatibility-specimens";

const W = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main";
const W14 = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml";
const W15 = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2012/wordml";
const R = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships";
const HYPERLINK = `${R}/hyperlink`;
const MAIN = "word/document.xml";
const replaceOnce = (text: string, from: string | RegExp, to: string): string => {
    const next = text.replace(from, to);
    if (next === text) throw new Error(`missing ${from}`);
    return next;
};

// tests/paraid-repair-w14-ignorable.test.ts: a main document whose root carries `rootAttributes` and whose two
// paragraphs and one table row have no ids.
const withoutParaIds = (rootAttributes: string): Record<string, string> => ({
    ...MINIMAL_PARTS,
    [MAIN]:
        `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n` +
        `<w:document xmlns:w="${W}"${rootAttributes}><w:body>` +
        `<w:p><w:r><w:t>one</w:t></w:r></w:p>` +
        `<w:tbl><w:tblPr><w:tblW w:w="0" w:type="auto"/></w:tblPr><w:tblGrid><w:gridCol w:w="4000"/></w:tblGrid>` +
        `<w:tr><w:tc><w:p/></w:tc></w:tr></w:tbl>` +
        `<w:sectPr><w:pgSz w:w="12240" w:h="15840"/></w:sectPr></w:body></w:document>`,
});

// The bytes repairMissingParaIds writes for `parts`, read back from the directory it repaired.
const workRoot = path.join(process.env.BUILD_DIR ?? ".", "..", "work");
const repairedParts = async (name: string, parts: Record<string, string>): Promise<Record<string, string>> => {
    const dir = path.join(workRoot, name);
    for (const [part, xml] of Object.entries(parts)) {
        mkdirSync(path.dirname(path.join(dir, part)), { recursive: true });
        writeFileSync(path.join(dir, part), xml, "utf-8");
    }
    const repairs = await new DOCXSchemaValidator({ unpackedDir: dir }).repairMissingParaIds();
    if (repairs !== 6) throw new Error(`${name}: expected 6 stamps, got ${repairs}`);
    const out: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const entry of readdirSync(dir, { recursive: true, withFileTypes: true })) {
        if (!entry.isFile()) continue;
        const file = path.join(entry.parentPath, entry.name);
        out[path.relative(dir, file).split(path.sep).join("/")] = readFileSync(file, "utf-8");
    }
    return out;
};
const repaired = async (name: string, rootAttributes: string) => buildDocx(await repairedParts(name, withoutParaIds(rootAttributes)));

// Release's repair shape: the same stamps with xmlns:w14 on each stamped element and the root left as it was.
const releaseShape = async () => {
    const parts = await repairedParts("653-release-repair-shape", withoutParaIds(""));
    const fixed = replaceOnce(parts[MAIN]!, ` xmlns:mc="${NS.MC}" xmlns:w14="${W14}" mc:Ignorable="w14"`, "");
    const release = fixed.replace(/<w:(p|tr) w14:paraId=/g, `<w:$1 xmlns:w14="${W14}" w14:paraId=`);
    if ((release.match(/xmlns:w14=/g) ?? []).length !== 3) throw new Error("release shape: expected three stamped elements");
    return buildDocx({ ...parts, [MAIN]: release });
};

// tests/rels-external-target.integration.test.ts: the minimal package plus hyperlink relationship rId9 to `target`,
// a direct child or inside a selected w14 Choice; `referenced` adds a w:hyperlink naming rId9.
const withHyperlink = (target: string, placement: "direct" | "choice", referenced = false) => {
    const relationship = `<Relationship Id="rId9" Type="${HYPERLINK}" Target="${target}" TargetMode="External"/>`;
    const content =
        placement === "direct"
            ? relationship
            : `<mc:AlternateContent><mc:Choice Requires="w14">${relationship}</mc:Choice><mc:Fallback/></mc:AlternateContent>`;
    const rels = MINIMAL_PARTS[DOCUMENT_RELS]!;
    const parts: Record<string, string> = {
        ...MINIMAL_PARTS,
        [DOCUMENT_RELS]: replaceOnce(
            placement === "direct" ? rels : replaceOnce(rels, "<Relationships ", `<Relationships ${MCE_DECLARATIONS} `),
            "</Relationships>",
            `${content}</Relationships>`,
        ),
    };
    if (referenced) {
        parts[MAIN] = replaceOnce(
            replaceOnce(parts[MAIN]!, "<w:document ", `<w:document xmlns:r="${R}" `),
            "<w:r><w:t>Hello</w:t></w:r>",
            `<w:hyperlink r:id="rId9"><w:r><w:t>Hello</w:t></w:r></w:hyperlink>`,
        );
    }
    return buildDocx(parts);
};
const control = () => buildDocx({ ...MINIMAL_PARTS });

const chunks: Record<string, Array<[string, string, () => Promise<Uint8Array>]>> = {
    s40a: [
        ["s40a-control-minimal", "control", control],
        [
            "653-repaired-root-w14",
            '#653: the repair\'s output for a root with neither w14 nor mc (root gains both, mc:Ignorable="w14")',
            () => repaired("653-repaired-root-w14", ""),
        ],
        [
            "653-repaired-root-w14-w15",
            '#653: the repair\'s output for a root listing w15 (mc:Ignorable="w15 w14")',
            () => repaired("653-repaired-root-w14-w15", ` xmlns:w15="${W15}" xmlns:mc="${NS.MC}" mc:Ignorable="w15"`),
        ],
        [
            "653-repaired-compat-prefix",
            '#653: the repair\'s output for a root binding compat to the MC namespace (compat:Ignorable="w15 w14")',
            () => repaired("653-repaired-compat-prefix", ` xmlns:compat="${NS.MC}" compat:Ignorable="w15" xmlns:w15="${W15}"`),
        ],
        ["653-release-repair-shape", "#653: release's output, xmlns:w14 on each stamped element and no Ignorable entry", releaseShape],
        [
            "665-external-file-pdf-direct",
            "#665: External hyperlink file:///C:/missing.pdf, direct child, no reference",
            () => withHyperlink("file:///C:/missing.pdf", "direct"),
        ],
        [
            "665-external-file-rels-direct",
            "#665: External hyperlink file:///missing.rels, direct child, no reference",
            () => withHyperlink("file:///missing.rels", "direct"),
        ],
        ["s40a-control-minimal-end", "control", control],
    ],
    s40b: [
        ["s40b-control-minimal", "control", control],
        [
            "665-external-file-rels-choice",
            "#665: External hyperlink file:///missing.rels in a selected w14 Choice",
            () => withHyperlink("file:///missing.rels", "choice"),
        ],
        [
            "665-external-underscore-rels-direct",
            "#665: External hyperlink file:///C:/docs/_rels/missing.xml, direct child",
            () => withHyperlink("file:///C:/docs/_rels/missing.xml", "direct"),
        ],
        [
            "665-external-underscore-rels-choice",
            "#665: External hyperlink file:///C:/docs/_rels/missing.xml in a selected w14 Choice",
            () => withHyperlink("file:///C:/docs/_rels/missing.xml", "choice"),
        ],
        [
            "665-external-customxml-direct",
            "#665: External hyperlink ../customXml/missing.xml, direct child",
            () => withHyperlink("../customXml/missing.xml", "direct"),
        ],
        [
            "665-external-customxml-choice",
            "#665: External hyperlink ../customXml/missing.xml in a selected w14 Choice",
            () => withHyperlink("../customXml/missing.xml", "choice"),
        ],
        [
            "665-external-file-rels-referenced",
            "#665: External hyperlink file:///missing.rels, direct child, named by a w:hyperlink",
            () => withHyperlink("file:///missing.rels", "direct", true),
        ],
        ["s40b-control-minimal-end", "control", control],
    ],
};

const chunk = process.env.CHUNK ?? "";
const specimens = chunks[chunk];
if (!specimens) throw new Error(`CHUNK must be one of ${Object.keys(chunks).join(", ")}`);
const dir = process.env.BUILD_DIR;
if (!dir) throw new Error("BUILD_DIR is required");
mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
for (const [name, issue, make] of specimens) {
    const bytes = await make();
    const file = `${name}.docx`;
    writeFileSync(path.join(dir, file), bytes);
    const sha256 = createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
    const verdict = async (profile: "word-valid" | "strict") => {
        try {
            const r = await validate(path.join(dir, file), { profile });
            return {
                valid: r.valid,
                errors: [...new Set(r.issues.filter((x) => x.severity === "error").map((x) => `${x.code}@${x.path ?? "-"}`))],
            };
        } catch (error) {
            return { valid: null, errors: [`threw:${(error as Error).name}:${(error as Error).message.slice(0, 80)}`] };
        }
    };
    const row = { name, issue, file, sha256, calibration: false, wordValid: await verdict("word-valid"), strict: await verdict("strict") };
    appendFileSync(path.join(dir, "..", "specimens.jsonl"), JSON.stringify(row) + "\n");
    console.log(
        `built ${file} ${sha256.slice(0, 16)} word-valid=${row.wordValid.valid} ${row.wordValid.errors.join(",")} strict=${row.strict.valid} ${row.strict.errors.join(",")}`,
    );
}
```

```ts
// Session 44 (2026-10-26): the scope questions of #647. Session 37 (s37b) saw Word open clean a chart part outside
// word/ (`charts/chart1.xml`, `c:externalData r:id="rId1"`, no sidecar) that a chart and an image relationship both
// reach and nothing references; word-valid still rejects it with `rels-missing-sidecar`, because #645 moved only a
// chart-only reach off the reach-based rule.
// s44a: the image relationship. s37b's mixed-reach specimen again, byte for byte (a second observation); the same chart reached only by an image relationship, unreferenced (question 1); an
// inline picture whose `a:blip r:embed` names that image relationship, with the image-only reach and with the mixed
// reach (question 2); the mixed reach referenced through the chart relationship (`c:chart r:id`), which session 36
// saw get the recovery offer under a chart-only reach; and a control for the blip: the same picture naming a chart part
// with no `c:externalData`, so no Id dangles.
// s44b: the other relationship types (question 3). The same unreferenced chart part reached only by a `diagramData`,
// an `oleObject` or a Microsoft `hdphoto` relationship; and the image-only reach, unreferenced and blip-referenced, of
// the chart stored under word/ (`word/charts/chart1.xml`), which word-valid judges as a Word-read part.
// s44c: the diagramData, oleObject and hdphoto reaches of s44b, unreferenced, of the chart stored under word/.
// Run from the layer 138 worktree root as a copy: BUILD_DIR=<chunk>/src CHUNK=s44a pnpm exec tsx s44builder.tmp.mts
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { appendFileSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { MINIMAL_PARTS, buildDocx } from "./tests/support/minimal-docx";

type Parts = Record<string, string>;
const R = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships";
const C = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/chart";
const A = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main";
const WP = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/wordprocessingDrawing";
const PIC = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/picture";
const CT = "[Content_Types].xml";
const SIDECAR = "word/_rels/document.xml.rels";
const XML_DECLARATION = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n';
const CHART_OUTSIDE = "charts/chart1.xml";

const replaceOnce = (text: string, from: string, to: string) => {
    if (text.split(from).length !== 2) throw new Error(`expected exactly one ${from}`);
    return text.replace(from, to);
};

// Session 36's bare chart, byte for byte as s37b's mixed-reach specimen stored it, and its twin with no external data.
const chart = (externalData: boolean) =>
    `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n<c:chartSpace xmlns:c="${C}" xmlns:r="${R}"><c:chart><c:plotArea><c:layout/></c:plotArea></c:chart>${externalData ? '<c:externalData r:id="rId1"/>' : ""}</c:chartSpace>`;

const relationship = (id: string, type: string, target: string) => `<Relationship Id="${id}" Type="${type}" Target="${target}"/>`;
const OFFICE = (segment: string) => `${R}/${segment}`;
const HDPHOTO = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/2007/relationships/hdphoto";

/** The chart part outside word/, its chart Override, and the given relationships from the main document's sidecar. */
const reachedChart = (externalData: boolean, ...relationships: string[]): Parts => ({
    ...MINIMAL_PARTS,
    [CHART_OUTSIDE]: chart(externalData),
    [SIDECAR]: replaceOnce(MINIMAL_PARTS[SIDECAR]!, "</Relationships>", `${relationships.join("")}</Relationships>`),
    [CT]: replaceOnce(
        MINIMAL_PARTS[CT]!,
        "</Types>",
        `<Override PartName="/${CHART_OUTSIDE}" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.drawingml.chart+xml"/></Types>`,
    ),
});
const CHART_INSIDE = "word/charts/chart1.xml";
/** The same chart stored under word/, related only by one relationship of `type` from the main document's sidecar. */
const reachedChartInside = (type: string): Parts => ({
    ...MINIMAL_PARTS,
    [CHART_INSIDE]: chart(true),
    [SIDECAR]: replaceOnce(
        MINIMAL_PARTS[SIDECAR]!,
        "</Relationships>",
        `${relationship("rId8", type, "charts/chart1.xml")}</Relationships>`,
    ),
    [CT]: replaceOnce(
        MINIMAL_PARTS[CT]!,
        "</Types>",
        `<Override PartName="/${CHART_INSIDE}" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.drawingml.chart+xml"/></Types>`,
    ),
});
const IMAGE_REL = relationship("rId8", OFFICE("image"), `../${CHART_OUTSIDE}`);
const CHART_REL = relationship("rId9", OFFICE("chart"), `../${CHART_OUTSIDE}`);

const PICTURE_DRAWING =
    '<w:p w14:paraId="00000002" w14:textId="00000002"><w:r><w:drawing><wp:inline distT="0" distB="0" distL="0" distR="0"><wp:extent cx="952500" cy="952500"/>' +
    '<wp:effectExtent l="0" t="0" r="0" b="0"/><wp:docPr id="1" name="Picture 1"/><wp:cNvGraphicFramePr><a:graphicFrameLocks noChangeAspect="1"/></wp:cNvGraphicFramePr>' +
    `<a:graphic><a:graphicData uri="${PIC}"><pic:pic><pic:nvPicPr><pic:cNvPr id="0" name="Picture 1"/><pic:cNvPicPr/></pic:nvPicPr>` +
    '<pic:blipFill><a:blip r:embed="rId8"/><a:stretch><a:fillRect/></a:stretch></pic:blipFill>' +
    '<pic:spPr><a:xfrm><a:off x="0" y="0"/><a:ext cx="952500" cy="952500"/></a:xfrm><a:prstGeom prst="rect"><a:avLst/></a:prstGeom></pic:spPr>' +
    "</pic:pic></a:graphicData></a:graphic></wp:inline></w:drawing></w:r></w:p>";
// s37b's chart drawing (session 36's referenced chart).
const CHART_DRAWING =
    '<w:p w14:paraId="00000002" w14:textId="00000002"><w:r><w:drawing><wp:inline distT="0" distB="0" distL="0" distR="0"><wp:extent cx="5486400" cy="3200400"/>' +
    '<wp:effectExtent l="0" t="0" r="0" b="0"/><wp:docPr id="1" name="Chart 1"/><wp:cNvGraphicFramePr/><a:graphic><a:graphicData uri="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/chart">' +
    '<c:chart r:id="rId9"/></a:graphicData></a:graphic></wp:inline></w:drawing></w:r></w:p>';
const withDrawing = (parts: Parts, drawing: string): Parts => ({
    ...parts,
    "word/document.xml": replaceOnce(
        replaceOnce(
            MINIMAL_PARTS["word/document.xml"]!,
            "<w:document ",
            `<w:document xmlns:wp="${WP}" xmlns:a="${A}" xmlns:pic="${PIC}" xmlns:c="${C}" xmlns:r="${R}" `,
        ),
        "<w:sectPr>",
        `${drawing}<w:sectPr>`,
    ),
});
const control = () => buildDocx({ ...MINIMAL_PARTS });
const PROBES = "/Users/arthrod/temp/T/docx-validate/.scratch/word-probes";
const copyOf = (file: string, shaPrefix: string) => async (): Promise<Uint8Array> => {
    const bytes = readFileSync(path.join(PROBES, file));
    const sha = createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
    if (!sha.startsWith(shaPrefix)) throw new Error(`${file} changed: ${sha}`);
    return bytes;
};

const chunks: Record<string, Array<[string, string, () => Promise<Uint8Array>]>> = {

            () => buildDocx(reachedChart(true, relationship("rId8", HDPHOTO, `../${CHART_OUTSIDE}`))),
        ],
        [
            "chart-word-image-only-reach-no-sidecar",
            "#647: word/charts/chart1.xml reached only by an image relationship, unreferenced",
            () => buildDocx(reachedChartInside(OFFICE("image"))),
        ],
        [
            "chart-word-image-only-blip-reference-no-sidecar",
            "#647: word/charts/chart1.xml reached only by an image relationship, a:blip r:embed names it",
            () => buildDocx(withDrawing(reachedChartInside(OFFICE("image")), PICTURE_DRAWING)),
        ],
        ["s44b-control-minimal-end", "control", control],
    ],
    s44c: [
        ["s44c-control-minimal", "control", control],
        [
            "chart-word-diagramdata-reach-no-sidecar",
            "#647 q3: word/charts/chart1.xml reached only by a diagramData relationship, unreferenced",
            () => buildDocx(reachedChartInside(OFFICE("diagramData"))),
        ],
        [
            "chart-word-oleobject-reach-no-sidecar",
            "#647 q3: word/charts/chart1.xml reached only by an oleObject relationship, unreferenced",
            () => buildDocx(reachedChartInside(OFFICE("oleObject"))),
        ],
        [
            "chart-word-hdphoto-reach-no-sidecar",
            "#647 q3: word/charts/chart1.xml reached only by a Microsoft hdphoto relationship, unreferenced",
            () => buildDocx(reachedChartInside(HDPHOTO)),
        ],
        ["s44c-control-minimal-end", "control", control],
    ],
};

const chunk = process.env.CHUNK ?? "";
const specimens = chunks[chunk];
if (!specimens) throw new Error(`CHUNK must be one of ${Object.keys(chunks).join(", ")}`);
const dir = process.env.BUILD_DIR;
if (!dir) throw new Error("BUILD_DIR is required");
mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
for (const [name, issue, make] of specimens) {
    const bytes = await make();
    const file = `${name}.docx`;
    writeFileSync(path.join(dir, file), bytes);
    const sha256 = createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
    const verdict = async (profile: "word-valid" | "strict") => {
        try {
            const r = await validate(path.join(dir, file), { profile });
            return {
                valid: r.valid,
                errors: [...new Set(r.issues.filter((x) => x.severity === "error").map((x) => `${x.code}@${x.path ?? "-"}`))],
            };
        } catch (error) {
            return { valid: null, errors: [`threw:${(error as Error).name}:${(error as Error).message.slice(0, 80)}`] };
        }
    };
    const row = { name, issue, file, sha256, calibration: false, wordValid: await verdict("word-valid"), strict: await verdict("strict") };
    appendFileSync(path.join(dir, "..", "specimens.jsonl"), JSON.stringify(row) + "\n");
    console.log(
        `built ${file} ${sha256.slice(0, 16)} word-valid=${row.wordValid.valid} ${row.wordValid.errors.join(",")} strict=${row.strict.valid} ${row.strict.errors.join(",")}`,
    );
}
```

`compare.py`:

```python
"""Join both passes of the session-44 chunks: log verdicts, table verdicts, validator verdicts, hashes."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path("/Users/arthrod/temp/T/docx-validate/.scratch/word-probes")
TO_MANIFEST = {"clean-open": "clean-open", "repair-warning": "unreadable-content-warning", "open-error": "open-error"}
REJECTIONS = {"repair-warning", "open-error"}
rows = []
for label in ("s44a", "s44b", "s44c"):
    specs = {json.loads(l)["file"]: json.loads(l) for l in (ROOT / label / "specimens.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()}
    passes = []
    for run in (ROOT / label, ROOT / label / "pass2"):
        for name, spec in specs.items():
            digest = hashlib.sha256((run / "src" / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            assert digest == spec["sha256"], f"{run}/{name}: {digest} != {spec['sha256']}"
        passes.append({json.loads(l)["file"]: json.loads(l) for l in (run / "logcheck.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()})
    assert set(passes[0]) == set(passes[1]) == set(specs), label
    for name, spec in specs.items():
        p1, p2 = passes[0][name], passes[1][name]
        readings = [p1["logVerdict"], p1["outcomesVerdict"], p2["logVerdict"], p2["outcomesVerdict"]]
        agreed = len(set(readings)) == 1 and not p1["conflict"] and not p2["conflict"]
        outcome = TO_MANIFEST.get(readings[0]) if agreed else "unknown"
        all_rejected = all(r in REJECTIONS for r in readings)
        all_clean = all(r == "clean-open" for r in readings)
        rows.append({"chunk": label, "file": name, "sha256": spec["sha256"], "readings": readings, "agreed": agreed,
                     "outcome": outcome, "everyReadingRejects": all_rejected, "everyReadingClean": all_clean,
                     "wordValid": spec["wordValid"]["valid"], "control": "control-minimal" in spec["name"],
                     "validatorMatchesWord": (all_rejected and spec["wordValid"]["valid"] is False) or (all_clean and spec["wordValid"]["valid"] is True)})
(ROOT / "s44/results.json").write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=2) + "\n")
for r in rows:
    print(f"{r['chunk']} {r["file"]:<62} {r['sha256'][:16]} outcome={r['outcome']:<27} readings={','.join(r['readings'])} word-valid={r['wordValid']} match={r['validatorMatchesWord']}")
print("agreed:", sum(r["agreed"] for r in rows), "/", len(rows), "| validator matches Word:", sum(r["validatorMatchesWord"] for r in rows), "/", len(rows))
```

SHAPE = {

    "chart-outside-word-image-only-blip-reference-no-externaldata": ("charts/chart1.xml", "image `rId8`", '`a:blip r:embed="rId8"`; the chart has no `c:externalData`'),
    "chart-outside-word-diagramdata-reach-no-sidecar": ("charts/chart1.xml", "diagramData `rId8`", "nothing"),
    "chart-outside-word-oleobject-reach-no-sidecar": ("charts/chart1.xml", "oleObject `rId8`", "nothing"),
    "chart-outside-word-hdphoto-reach-no-sidecar": ("charts/chart1.xml", "Microsoft hdphoto `rId8`", "nothing"),
    "chart-word-image-only-reach-no-sidecar": ("word/charts/chart1.xml", "image `rId8`", "nothing"),

    "chart-word-hdphoto-reach-no-sidecar": ("word/charts/chart1.xml", "Microsoft hdphoto `rId8`", "nothing"),
}
results = {(r["chunk"], r["file"]): r for r in json.loads((ROOT / "s44/results.json").read_text())}


def cell(v):
    return "valid" if v["valid"] else "invalid: " + ", ".join(f"`{e.split('@')[0]}`" for e in v["errors"])


def run_at(run, file):
    for line in (run / "pdf/manifest.jsonl").read_text().splitlines():
        row = json.loads(line)
        if row["original_filename"] == file:
            return datetime.fromisoformat(row["run_at"]).astimezone(timezone.utc)
    raise KeyError(file)


def word_cell(check):
    log, table = check["logVerdict"], check["outcomesVerdict"]
    return log if log == table else f"log: {log}; table: {table}"


rows, raw = [], []
for label in ("s44a", "s44b", "s44c"):
    specs = [json.loads(l) for l in (ROOT / label / "specimens.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
    runs = [ROOT / label, ROOT / label / "pass2"]
    checks = [{json.loads(l)["file"]: json.loads(l) for l in (r / "logcheck.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()} for r in runs]
    for s in specs:
        times = [run_at(r, s["file"]) for r in runs]
        part, reach, reference = SHAPE.get(s["name"], (None, "none (control)", "-"))
        stored = "-" if part is None else f"`{part}`"
        result = results[(label, s["file"])]
        rows.append(

            f"{word_cell(checks[0][s['file']])} | {word_cell(checks[1][s['file']])} | {result['outcome']} | {cell(s['wordValid'])} | {cell(s['strict'])} |"
        )
        for n, (r, c, t) in enumerate(zip(runs, checks, times), start=1):
            row = c[s["file"]]
            raw.append(json.dumps({"run": label, "pass": n, "name": s["name"], "sha256": s["sha256"],
                                   "observedAt": t.isoformat(), "staged": row["staged"], "logVerdict": row["logVerdict"],
                                   "tableVerdict": row["outcomesVerdict"], "pdf": row["pdf"], "evidence": row["evidence"]}, ensure_ascii=False))

out = [
    "### Session 44: 06:56Z–07:01Z on 2026-10-26, validator columns at 37a691ce",
    "",
    "The scope questions of [#647](https://github.com/jandira-tech/docx-validate/issues/647): which relationship types "
    "make Word load a part whose own relationships part is missing. Every specimen but the controls holds session 36's "
    "bare chart (`c:externalData r:id=\"rId1\"`, no `.rels` beside it, a chart Override) reached from "
    "`word/_rels/document.xml.rels`: `s44a` varies the image relationship and the reference, `s44b` and `s44c` the type "
    "and the folder. `chart-outside-word-mixed-reach-no-sidecar` is s37b's specimen, copied byte for byte. Each chunk "
    "ran twice, as two separate driver runs of byte-identical copies, and each run's rows were read twice: from its own "
    "Word log (session 41's `logcheck.py`) and by `wordpdf_outcomes.py`. Outcome is the manifest spelling when both "
    "runs and both readings agree, and `unknown` otherwise; all 20 rows agree. The two times in Observed are the ends "
    "of the first and second runs.",
    "",
    "| Run | Observed | Specimen | Chart part | Reached by | Referenced by | SHA-256 (first 16) | Word, run 1 | Word, run 2 | Outcome | word-valid at 37a691ce | strict at 37a691ce |",
    "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |",
    *rows,
    "",
    "<details><summary>Raw records, session 44</summary>",

    *raw,

]
for name, path, lang in (("s44builder.mts", ROOT / "s44builder.mts", "ts"), ("compare.py", ROOT / "s44/compare.py", "python"),

    out += [f"`{name}`:", "", f"````{lang}", path.read_text().rstrip("\n"), "````", ""]
out += ["</details>", ""]
(ROOT / "s44/section.md").write_text("\n".join(out))
print(len(rows), "rows,", len(raw), "raw records")

### Session 45: 08:05Z–08:54Z on 2026-10-26, validator columns at dbbbdc47

The questions of [#694](https://github.com/jandira-tech/docx-validate/issues/694) (two relationships of a type Word reads once), [#702](https://github.com/jandira-tech/docx-validate/issues/702) (reference shapes of a chart part with no sidecar that Word was never shown) and the cause behind [#701](https://github.com/jandira-tech/docx-validate/issues/701)'s rows. Each chunk ran twice, as two separate driver runs of byte-identical copies, and each run's rows were read twice: from its own Word log (session 41's `logcheck.py`) and by `wordpdf_outcomes.py`. Outcome is the manifest spelling when both runs and both readings agree, and `unknown` otherwise; all 62 rows agree. The two times in Observed are the ends of the first and second runs. Shape is the builder's description of the specimen.

- `s45a`–`s45b`, #694: each probe document holds a `Heading1` paragraph `MARKER`; one styles part defines `Heading1` with `w:vanish` and the other without it. Alone, each opens clean and renders as designed (pdftotext: `Hello` for the vanishing part, `Hello MARKER` for the visible one). Two `styles` relationships get the recovery offer whichever part is listed first and whichever Id it has, and so do two `officeDocument` relationships (word-valid already rejects those with `word-main-document-part`).
- `s45f`–`s45g`, #694's scope: two `styles` relationships to the same part and two `numbering` relationships also get the recovery offer; two `footnotes` relationships open clean. The doubled `settings`, `fontTable` and `webSettings` rows repeat earlier sessions' verdicts, which the existing `word-duplicate-*-relationship` rules already block.
- `s45b`–`s45d`, #702, with session 36's bare chart (`c:plotArea` with no chart type, `c:externalData r:id`, no sidecar): D1a (`dgm:relIds` names the chart's Id) gets the recovery offer, under `word/` and outside it; D1b (VML `v:imagedata o:relid`) opens clean; S1 (a picture's `a:blip r:embed` names a `diagramData` or `oleObject` relationship to the chart) opens clean, where word-valid rejects it; S2 (an External `chart` relationship with an internal-looking target, named by `c:chart r:id`) gets the recovery offer; S3 (an `image` relationship in `_rels/.rels` targeting the chart) opens clean. #701's three rows (`c:chart`, `dgm:relIds` or `o:OLEObject` naming an image relationship to the chart) get the recovery offer.
- `s45h`–`s45k`, the causes, with session 36d's clustered bar chart in place of the bare one: the bar chart with no `c:externalData` and no sidecar opens clean under `c:chart r:id` (s36d's control again), but gets the recovery offer when `dgm:relIds` names its chart relationship, so D1a is refused for the reference, not the missing sidecar. S2's refusal needs no part at all: an External `chart` relationship to `http://example.com/chart1.xml` named by `c:chart r:id` gets the same offer. An image relationship to a real PNG gets the offer when `c:chart`, `dgm:relIds` or `o:OLEObject` names it, and so does an image relationship to the bar chart under `c:chart`: #701's rows are refused for the reference's type, whatever the target.
- `s45e` asked the cause questions first, with the bare chart, eight specimens in one run. After an open error on its first specimen the driver hit AppleEvent timeouts and recovered Word four times; most rows have no dialog in the log, and the chunk never got a second run. Its rows are not recorded here; `s45h`–`s45k` re-ask them.
