// Session 49 (2026-10-26): the shapes review 145-146 says layers 145 (#707) and 146 (#694) judge without evidence.
// - s49a: session 46 saw Word refuse a styles part typed `application/octet-stream` by a Default (`word/styles.bin`).
//   `word-part-content-type-unrecognized` claims the recovery offer for any unrecognised type on the main styles reach
//   (review finding 1). Here `word/styles.xml` keeps its XML and its Override carries the type: octet-stream itself (the
//   Override spelling session 46 did not show), upper case, with a parameter, `image/png` and `application/foo+xml`.
// - s49b: an empty `ContentType=""` on the styles Override (finding 6), the main document's Override typed
//   `application/octet-stream` (finding 7) and the styles Override typed with the settings type (finding 8's hole).
// - s49c: two styles relationships outside the main document's relationships part, in `_rels/.rels`, a reached header's
//   sidecar and a reached glossary's sidecar (finding 3), and one real styles relationship beside an External one
//   (finding 4). Session 45 refused two internal styles relationships in `word/_rels/document.xml.rels` only.
// Run from a worktree root as a copy: BUILD_DIR=<chunk>/src CHUNK=s49a pnpm exec tsx s49builder.tmp.mts
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { appendFileSync, mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { MINIMAL_PARTS, buildDocx } from "./tests/support/minimal-docx";
import { validate } from "./src/scripts/office/validate";

const W = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main";
const REL = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships";
const WML = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml";
const CT = "[Content_Types].xml";
const SIDECAR = "word/_rels/document.xml.rels";
const STYLES_TYPE = `${WML}.styles+xml`;
const MAIN_TYPE = `${WML}.document.main+xml`;
const P = MINIMAL_PARTS as Record<string, string>;

const replaceOnce = (text: string, from: string, to: string) => {
    if (text.split(from).length !== 2) throw new Error(`expected exactly one ${from}`);
    return text.replace(from, to);
};
const relationship = (id: string, segment: string, target: string, external = false) =>
    `<Relationship Id="${id}" Type="${REL}/${segment}" Target="${target}"${external ? ' TargetMode="External"' : ""}/>`;
const relsPart = (body: string) =>
    `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">${body}</Relationships>`;
const mainRels = (extra: string) => replaceOnce(P[SIDECAR]!, "</Relationships>", `${extra}</Relationships>`);
const withOverrides = (...overrides: Array<[string, string]>) =>
    replaceOnce(
        P[CT]!,
        "</Types>",
        `${overrides.map(([part, type]) => `<Override PartName="/${part}" ContentType="${type}"/>`).join("")}</Types>`,
    );
const control = () => buildDocx({ ...P });

/** The minimal package with the Override of `part` carrying `type` instead of its own. */
const retypedOverride = (part: string, own: string, type: string) =>
    buildDocx({
        ...P,
        [CT]: replaceOnce(
            P[CT]!,
            `<Override PartName="/${part}" ContentType="${own}"/>`,
            `<Override PartName="/${part}" ContentType="${type}"/>`,
        ),
    });
const stylesTyped = (type: string) => retypedOverride("word/styles.xml", STYLES_TYPE, type);

const STYLES2: Record<string, string> = { "word/styles2.xml": P["word/styles.xml"]! };
/** Two more styles relationships in the package relationships part, beside the main document's own. */
const dupInPackageRels = () =>
    buildDocx({
        ...P,
        ...STYLES2,
        "_rels/.rels": replaceOnce(
            P["_rels/.rels"]!,
            "</Relationships>",
            `${relationship("rId8", "styles", "word/styles.xml")}${relationship("rId9", "styles", "word/styles2.xml")}</Relationships>`,
        ),
        [CT]: withOverrides(["word/styles2.xml", STYLES_TYPE]),
    });
const HEADER = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n<w:hdr xmlns:w="${W}"><w:p><w:r><w:t>Header</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:hdr>`;
/** A header the body section references, its own sidecar holding two styles relationships. */
const dupInHeaderRels = () =>
    buildDocx({
        ...P,
        ...STYLES2,
        "word/document.xml": replaceOnce(
            replaceOnce(P["word/document.xml"]!, `xmlns:w="${W}"`, `xmlns:w="${W}" xmlns:r="${REL}"`),
            "<w:sectPr>",
            `<w:sectPr><w:headerReference w:type="default" r:id="rIdH"/>`,
        ),
        "word/header9.xml": HEADER,
        "word/_rels/header9.xml.rels": relsPart(
            `${relationship("rId1", "styles", "styles.xml")}${relationship("rId2", "styles", "styles2.xml")}`,
        ),
        [SIDECAR]: mainRels(relationship("rIdH", "header", "header9.xml")),
        [CT]: withOverrides(["word/header9.xml", `${WML}.header+xml`], ["word/styles2.xml", STYLES_TYPE]),
    });
const GLOSSARY =
    `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n<w:glossaryDocument xmlns:w="${W}"><w:docParts><w:docPart><w:docPartPr><w:name w:val="Part"/>` +
    `<w:category><w:name w:val="General"/><w:gallery w:val="placeholder"/></w:category><w:guid w:val="{6A9E2C40-3F1B-4C55-9D2E-7B1A0C9D4E11}"/></w:docPartPr>` +
    `<w:docPartBody><w:p><w:r><w:t>Part</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:docPartBody></w:docPart></w:docParts></w:glossaryDocument>`;
/** A reached glossary whose own sidecar holds two styles relationships to two parts. */
const dupInGlossaryRels = () =>
    buildDocx({
        ...P,
        "word/glossary/document.xml": GLOSSARY,
        "word/glossary/styles.xml": P["word/styles.xml"]!,
        "word/glossary/styles2.xml": P["word/styles.xml"]!,
        "word/glossary/_rels/document.xml.rels": relsPart(
            `${relationship("rId1", "styles", "styles.xml")}${relationship("rId2", "styles", "styles2.xml")}`,
        ),
        [SIDECAR]: mainRels(relationship("rIdG", "glossaryDocument", "glossary/document.xml")),
        [CT]: withOverrides(
            ["word/glossary/document.xml", `${WML}.document.glossary+xml`],
            ["word/glossary/styles.xml", STYLES_TYPE],
            ["word/glossary/styles2.xml", STYLES_TYPE],
        ),
    });
/** The main document's real styles relationship beside `count` External ones. */
const withExternalStyles = (count: number) =>
    buildDocx({
        ...P,
        [SIDECAR]: mainRels(
            Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) =>
                relationship(`rIdX${i + 1}`, "styles", `http://example.com/styles${i + 1}.xml`, true),
            ).join(""),
        ),
    });
/** Session 45's refused shape again, as the chunk's calibration: two internal styles relationships to two parts. */
const dupInMainRels = () =>
    buildDocx({
        ...P,
        ...STYLES2,
        [SIDECAR]: mainRels(relationship("rId9", "styles", "styles2.xml")),
        [CT]: withOverrides(["word/styles2.xml", STYLES_TYPE]),
    });

const chunks: Record<string, Array<[string, string, () => Promise<Uint8Array>]>> = {
    s49a: [
        ["s49a-control-minimal", "control", control],
        [
            "styles-override-octet",
            "#707 F1: word/styles.xml (styles XML) Override typed application/octet-stream",
            () => stylesTyped("application/octet-stream"),
        ],
        [
            "styles-override-octet-upper",
            "#707 F1: styles Override typed APPLICATION/OCTET-STREAM",
            () => stylesTyped("APPLICATION/OCTET-STREAM"),
        ],
        [
            "styles-override-octet-charset",
            "#707 F1: styles Override typed application/octet-stream; charset=utf-8",
            () => stylesTyped("application/octet-stream; charset=utf-8"),
        ],
        ["styles-override-image-png", "#707 F1: styles Override typed image/png", () => stylesTyped("image/png")],
        ["styles-override-foo-xml", "#707 F1: styles Override typed application/foo+xml", () => stylesTyped("application/foo+xml")],
        ["s49a-control-minimal-end", "control", control],
    ],
    s49b: [
        ["s49b-control-minimal", "control", control],
        ["styles-override-empty", '#707 F6: styles Override ContentType=""', () => stylesTyped("")],
        [
            "main-override-octet",
            "#707 F7: main document Override typed application/octet-stream",
            () => retypedOverride("word/document.xml", MAIN_TYPE, "application/octet-stream"),
        ],
        [
            "styles-override-settings-type",
            "#707 F8: styles Override typed with the settings content type",
            () => stylesTyped(`${WML}.settings+xml`),
        ],
        ["s49b-control-minimal-end", "control", control],
    ],
    s49c: [
        ["s49c-control-minimal", "control", control],
        [
            "dup-styles-main-calibration",
            "calibration (s45's refused shape): two internal styles relationships in word/_rels/document.xml.rels",
            dupInMainRels,
        ],
        [
            "dup-styles-package-rels",
            "#694 F3: _rels/.rels adds two styles relationships (word/styles.xml, word/styles2.xml)",
            dupInPackageRels,
        ],
        ["dup-styles-header-sidecar", "#694 F3: a referenced header's sidecar holds two styles relationships", dupInHeaderRels],
        [
            "dup-styles-glossary-sidecar",
            "#694 F3: a reached glossary's sidecar holds two styles relationships to two parts",
            dupInGlossaryRels,
        ],
        [
            "styles-plus-one-external",
            "#694 F4: the real styles relationship plus one External styles relationship",
            () => withExternalStyles(1),
        ],
        [
            "styles-plus-two-external",
            "#694 F4: the real styles relationship plus two External styles relationships",
            () => withExternalStyles(2),
        ],
        ["s49c-control-minimal-end", "control", control],
    ],
};

const chunk = process.env.CHUNK ?? "";
const specimens = chunks[chunk];
if (!specimens) throw new Error(`CHUNK must be one of ${Object.keys(chunks).join(", ")}`);
const dir = process.env.BUILD_DIR;
if (!dir) throw new Error("BUILD_DIR is required");
mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
for (const [name, issue, make] of specimens) {
    const bytes = await make();
    const file = `${name}.docx`;
    writeFileSync(path.join(dir, file), bytes);
    const sha256 = createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
    const verdict = async (profile: "word-valid" | "strict") => {
        try {
            const r = await validate(path.join(dir, file), { profile });
            return {
                valid: r.valid,
                errors: [...new Set(r.issues.filter((x) => x.severity === "error").map((x) => `${x.code}@${x.path ?? "-"}`))],
            };
        } catch (error) {
            return { valid: null, errors: [`threw:${(error as Error).name}:${(error as Error).message.slice(0, 80)}`] };
        }
    };
    const row = {
        name,
        issue,
        file,
        sha256,
        calibration: name.includes("calibration"),
        wordValid: await verdict("word-valid"),
        strict: await verdict("strict"),
    };
    appendFileSync(path.join(dir, "..", "specimens.jsonl"), JSON.stringify(row) + "\n");
    console.log(
        `built ${file} ${sha256.slice(0, 16)} word-valid=${row.wordValid.valid} ${row.wordValid.errors.join(",")} strict=${row.strict.valid} ${row.strict.errors.join(",")}`,
    );
}

"""Join both passes of the session-49 chunks: log verdicts, table verdicts, validator verdicts, hashes."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path("/Users/arthrod/temp/T/docx-validate/.scratch/word-probes")
CHUNKS = ("s49a", "s49b", "s49c")
TO_MANIFEST = {"clean-open": "clean-open", "repair-warning": "unreadable-content-warning", "open-error": "open-error"}
REJECTIONS = {"repair-warning", "open-error"}
rows = []
for label in CHUNKS:
    specs = {json.loads(l)["file"]: json.loads(l) for l in (ROOT / label / "specimens.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()}
    passes = []
    for run in (ROOT / label, ROOT / label / "pass2"):
        for name, spec in specs.items():
            digest = hashlib.sha256((run / "src" / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            assert digest == spec["sha256"], f"{run}/{name}: {digest} != {spec['sha256']}"
        passes.append({json.loads(l)["file"]: json.loads(l) for l in (run / "logcheck.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()})
    assert set(passes[0]) == set(passes[1]) == set(specs), label
    for name, spec in specs.items():
        p1, p2 = passes[0][name], passes[1][name]
        readings = [p1["logVerdict"], p1["outcomesVerdict"], p2["logVerdict"], p2["outcomesVerdict"]]
        agreed = len(set(readings)) == 1 and not p1["conflict"] and not p2["conflict"]
        outcome = TO_MANIFEST.get(readings[0]) if agreed else "unknown"
        all_rejected = all(r in REJECTIONS for r in readings)
        all_clean = all(r == "clean-open" for r in readings)
        rows.append({"chunk": label, "file": name, "sha256": spec["sha256"], "readings": readings, "agreed": agreed,
                     "outcome": outcome, "everyReadingRejects": all_rejected, "everyReadingClean": all_clean,
                     "wordValid": spec["wordValid"]["valid"], "control": "control-minimal" in spec["name"],
                     "validatorMatchesWord": (all_rejected and spec["wordValid"]["valid"] is False) or (all_clean and spec["wordValid"]["valid"] is True)})
(ROOT / "s49/results.json").write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=2) + "\n")
for r in rows:
    print(f"{r['chunk']} {r['file']:<58} {r['sha256'][:16]} outcome={r['outcome']:<27} word-valid={r['wordValid']!s:<5} match={r['validatorMatchesWord']}")
print("agreed:", sum(r["agreed"] for r in rows), "/", len(rows), "| validator matches Word:", sum(r["validatorMatchesWord"] for r in rows), "/", len(rows))
```

"""Render the session-49 parts of docs/plans/evidence/word-probes-2026-10-24.md into s49/section.md.

Reads the chunk's specimens.jsonl (validator columns at e762ffb5, written by the builder), both runs'
logcheck.jsonl and pdf/manifest.jsonl, and s49/results.json from compare.py.
"""
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path("/Users/arthrod/temp/T/docx-validate/.scratch/word-probes")
CHUNKS = ("s49a", "s49b", "s49c")
results = {(r["chunk"], r["file"]): r for r in json.loads((ROOT / "s49/results.json").read_text())}


def cell(v):
    return "valid" if v["valid"] else "invalid: " + ", ".join(f"`{e.split('@')[0]}`" for e in v["errors"])


def run_at(run, file):
    for line in (run / "pdf/manifest.jsonl").read_text().splitlines():
        row = json.loads(line)
        if row["original_filename"] == file:
            return datetime.fromisoformat(row["run_at"]).astimezone(timezone.utc)
    raise KeyError(file)


def word_cell(check):
    log, table = check["logVerdict"], check["outcomesVerdict"]
    return log if log == table else f"log: {log}; table: {table}"


rows, raw, starts, ends = [], [], [], []
for label in CHUNKS:
    specs = [json.loads(l) for l in (ROOT / label / "specimens.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
    runs = [ROOT / label, ROOT / label / "pass2"]
    checks = [{json.loads(l)["file"]: json.loads(l) for l in (r / "logcheck.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()} for r in runs]
    for s in specs:
        times = [run_at(r, s["file"]) for r in runs]
        starts.append(times[0])
        ends.append(times[1])
        result = results[(label, s["file"])]
        shape = s["issue"].replace("|", "\\|")
        rows.append(
            f"| `{label}` | {times[0]:%H:%M:%S}Z, {times[1]:%H:%M:%S}Z | `{s['name']}` | {shape} | `{s['sha256'][:16]}` | "
            f"{word_cell(checks[0][s['file']])} | {word_cell(checks[1][s['file']])} | {result['outcome']} | {cell(s['wordValid'])} | {cell(s['strict'])} |"
        )
        for n, (r, c, t) in enumerate(zip(runs, checks, times), start=1):
            row = c[s["file"]]
            raw.append(json.dumps({"run": label, "pass": n, "name": s["name"], "sha256": s["sha256"],
                                   "observedAt": t.isoformat(), "staged": row["staged"], "logVerdict": row["logVerdict"],
                                   "tableVerdict": row["outcomesVerdict"], "pdf": row["pdf"], "evidence": row["evidence"]}, ensure_ascii=False))

out = [
    f"### Session 49: {min(starts):%H:%M}Z–{max(ends):%H:%M}Z on 2026-10-26, validator columns at e762ffb5",
    "",
    "The shapes the adversarial review of layers 145 ([#707](https://github.com/jandira-tech/docx-validate/issues/707)) and "
    "146 ([#694](https://github.com/jandira-tech/docx-validate/issues/694)) said those layers judge without evidence. Each chunk ran "
    "twice, as two separate driver runs of byte-identical copies, and each run's rows were read twice: from its own Word log "
    "(session 41's `logcheck.py`) and by `wordpdf_outcomes.py`. Outcome is the manifest spelling when both runs and both readings "
    "agree, and `unknown` otherwise; all 20 rows agree. The two times in Observed are the ends of the first and second runs. "
    "Shape is the builder's description of the specimen.",
    "",
    "- `s49a`, #707: the minimal package with `word/styles.xml` (styles XML) typed by its Override as `application/octet-stream` "
    "(session 46 showed only the Default spelling, on `word/styles.bin`), `APPLICATION/OCTET-STREAM`, "
    "`application/octet-stream; charset=utf-8`, `image/png` or `application/foo+xml`: Word gets the recovery offer for every one. "
    "Word-valid rejects all five through `word-part-content-type-unrecognized`.",
    "- `s49b`, #707: an empty `ContentType=\"\"` on the styles Override, the main document's Override typed `application/octet-stream`, "
    "and the styles Override typed with the settings content type: Word gets the recovery offer for all three, and word-valid "
    "passes all three (false negatives).",
    "- `s49c`, #694: two more styles relationships in `_rels/.rels`, and two in the sidecar of a header the body references, open "
    "clean; word-valid rejects both through `word-duplicate-styles-relationship` (false positives). Two styles relationships in a "
    "reached glossary's sidecar get the recovery offer, as session 45's calibration in the main document's sidecar does again. The "
    "main document's real styles relationship beside one or two External styles relationships gets the recovery offer; word-valid "
    "rejects both.",
    "",
    "| Run | Observed | Specimen | Shape | SHA-256 (first 16) | Word, run 1 | Word, run 2 | Outcome | word-valid at e762ffb5 | strict at e762ffb5 |",
    "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |",
    *rows,
    "",
    "<details><summary>Raw records, session 49</summary>",
    "",
    "```jsonl",
    *raw,

]
for name, path, lang in (("s49builder.mts", ROOT / "s49builder.mts", "ts"), ("compare.py", ROOT / "s49/compare.py", "python"),

### Session 50: 11:26Z–11:40Z on 2026-10-26, validator columns at 01e4e684

The scope the session 49 follow-ups need: where Word refuses duplicate relationships ([#717](https://github.com/jandira-tech/docx-validate/issues/717)), and which content types it refuses on the main document and the other parts it relates ([#720](https://github.com/jandira-tech/docx-validate/issues/720), [#721](https://github.com/jandira-tech/docx-validate/issues/721), [#722](https://github.com/jandira-tech/docx-validate/issues/722)). Each chunk ran twice, as two separate driver runs of byte-identical copies, and each run's rows were read twice: from its own Word log (session 41's `logcheck.py`) and by `wordpdf_outcomes.py`. Outcome is the manifest spelling when both runs and both readings agree, and `unknown` otherwise; all 32 rows agree. The two times in Observed are the ends of the first and second runs. Shape is the builder's description of the specimen. The part bodies are session 47's empty roots; the theme part is `word/theme/theme1.xml` of `tests/fixtures/working/package.drawing-arc-radius-integer.docx` (clean-open in the manifest).

- `s50a` and `s50b`, #717: two relationships of one kind outside the main document's relationships part. In `_rels/.rels` (beside the main document's own relationship of the kind) two numbering, settings or theme relationships open clean, as styles did in session 49; in the sidecar of a header the body references, two numbering, settings, fontTable, webSettings or theme relationships open clean. In a reached glossary's sidecar, two numbering, settings or fontTable relationships to two parts get the recovery offer, as styles did; so does session 45's numbering calibration in `word/_rels/document.xml.rels`. // Session 50 (2026-10-26): the scope the session 49 follow-ups (#717, #720, #721, #722) need before they are implemented.
// - s50a/s50b: #717. Session 49 opened clean two extra styles relationships in `_rels/.rels` and in a referenced
//   header's sidecar, and refused them in a reached glossary's sidecar. Here the same three reaches with two numbering,
//   settings, fontTable, webSettings or theme relationships; session 45 refused two of each only in
//   `word/_rels/document.xml.rels` (numbering re-run here as the calibration).
// - s50c: #721 and #720. Session 49 refused the main document's Override typed `application/octet-stream` and the
//   styles Override with `ContentType=""`. Here the main document typed with the other s49a spellings (upper case, a
//   parameter, `image/png`, `application/foo+xml`), and an empty ContentType on a related settings and fontTable part.
// - s50d: #722 and review finding 1's reach. Session 49 refused styles typed `application/octet-stream` and typed with
//   the settings type. Here settings, fontTable and numbering typed `application/octet-stream`, settings typed with
//   the styles type, numbering with the settings type, and the main document with the styles type.

import { appendFileSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import JSZip from "jszip";

const REL = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships";
const WML = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml";
const CT = "[Content_Types].xml";
const SIDECAR = "word/_rels/document.xml.rels";
const MAIN_TYPE = `${WML}.document.main+xml`;
const STYLES_TYPE = `${WML}.styles+xml`;
const P = MINIMAL_PARTS as Record<string, string>;
const XML_DECL = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n`;

/** A Word-clean fixture's theme part (Word 16.115 clean-open in the manifest). */
const THEME_XML = await (async () => {
    const zip = await JSZip.loadAsync(readFileSync("tests/fixtures/working/package.drawing-arc-radius-integer.docx"));
    const file = zip.file("word/theme/theme1.xml");
    if (!file) throw new Error("theme fixture lost word/theme/theme1.xml");
    return file.async("string");
})();

type Kind = "numbering" | "settings" | "fontTable" | "webSettings" | "theme";
/** The relationship segment, the part body and the content type of each kind (the bodies session 47 used). */
const KINDS: Record<Kind, { root: string; ct: string }> = {
    numbering: { root: `${XML_DECL}<w:numbering xmlns:w="${W}"/>`, ct: `${WML}.numbering+xml` },
    settings: { root: `${XML_DECL}<w:settings xmlns:w="${W}"/>`, ct: `${WML}.settings+xml` },
    fontTable: { root: `${XML_DECL}<w:fonts xmlns:w="${W}"/>`, ct: `${WML}.fontTable+xml` },
    webSettings: { root: `${XML_DECL}<w:webSettings xmlns:w="${W}"/>`, ct: `${WML}.webSettings+xml` },
    theme: { root: THEME_XML, ct: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.theme+xml" },
};
/** Where a kind's parts live: `theme/theme1.xml` for the theme, `<kind>.xml` otherwise. */
const fileOf = (kind: Kind, n: 1 | 2) => (kind === "theme" ? `theme/theme${n}.xml` : `${kind}${n === 1 ? "" : "2"}.xml`);

const replaceOnce = (text: string, from: string, to: string) => {
    if (text.split(from).length !== 2) throw new Error(`expected exactly one ${from}`);
    return text.replace(from, to);
};
const relationship = (id: string, segment: string, target: string) =>
    `<Relationship Id="${id}" Type="${REL}/${segment}" Target="${target}"/>`;
const relsPart = (body: string) =>
    `${XML_DECL}<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">${body}</Relationships>`;
const appendRels = (rels: string, extra: string) => replaceOnce(rels, "</Relationships>", `${extra}</Relationships>`);
const overrides = (ct: string, ...entries: Array<[string, string]>) =>
    replaceOnce(

    );

/** The minimal package plus `word/<file of kind>` related from the main document's sidecar as rId2. */
const withRelated = (kind: Kind, type = KINDS[kind].ct): Record<string, string> => ({
    ...P,
    [`word/${fileOf(kind, 1)}`]: KINDS[kind].root,
    [SIDECAR]: appendRels(P[SIDECAR]!, relationship("rId2", kind, fileOf(kind, 1))),
    [CT]: overrides(P[CT]!, [`word/${fileOf(kind, 1)}`, type]),
});
/** {@link withRelated} with the Override of the related part (or of `part`) carrying `type`. */
const relatedTyped = (kind: Kind, type: string) => buildDocx(withRelated(kind, type));
const retyped = (part: string, own: string, type: string) =>
    buildDocx({
        ...P,
        [CT]: replaceOnce(
            P[CT]!,
            `<Override PartName="/${part}" ContentType="${own}"/>`,
            `<Override PartName="/${part}" ContentType="${type}"/>`,
        ),
    });
const mainTyped = (type: string) => retyped("word/document.xml", MAIN_TYPE, type);

const dupInMainRels = (kind: Kind) => {
    const parts = withRelated(kind);
    return buildDocx({
        ...parts,
        [`word/${fileOf(kind, 2)}`]: KINDS[kind].root,

        [CT]: overrides(parts[CT]!, [`word/${fileOf(kind, 2)}`, KINDS[kind].ct]),
    });
};
/** The main document's own `kind` relationship, and two more of `kind` in `_rels/.rels` (s49c's styles shape). */
const dupInPackageRels = (kind: Kind) => {
    const parts = withRelated(kind);

        ...parts,

        "_rels/.rels": appendRels(
            P["_rels/.rels"]!,
            `${relationship("rId8", kind, `word/${fileOf(kind, 1)}`)}${relationship("rId9", kind, `word/${fileOf(kind, 2)}`)}`,
        ),
        [CT]: overrides(parts[CT]!, [`word/${fileOf(kind, 2)}`, KINDS[kind].ct]),
    });
};
const HEADER = `${XML_DECL}<w:hdr xmlns:w="${W}"><w:p><w:r><w:t>Header</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:hdr>`;
/** The main document's own `kind` relationship, and a referenced header whose sidecar holds two of `kind`. */
const dupInHeaderRels = (kind: Kind) => {
    const parts = withRelated(kind);
    return buildDocx({
        ...parts,
        [`word/${fileOf(kind, 2)}`]: KINDS[kind].root,
        "word/document.xml": replaceOnce(
            replaceOnce(P["word/document.xml"]!, `xmlns:w="${W}"`, `xmlns:w="${W}" xmlns:r="${REL}"`),
            "<w:sectPr>",
            `<w:sectPr><w:headerReference w:type="default" r:id="rIdH"/>`,
        ),
        "word/header9.xml": HEADER,
        "word/_rels/header9.xml.rels": relsPart(
            `${relationship("rId1", kind, fileOf(kind, 1))}${relationship("rId2", kind, fileOf(kind, 2))}`,
        ),
        [SIDECAR]: appendRels(parts[SIDECAR]!, relationship("rIdH", "header", "header9.xml")),
        [CT]: overrides(parts[CT]!, ["word/header9.xml", `${WML}.header+xml`], [`word/${fileOf(kind, 2)}`, KINDS[kind].ct]),
    });
};
const GLOSSARY =
    `${XML_DECL}<w:glossaryDocument xmlns:w="${W}"><w:docParts><w:docPart><w:docPartPr><w:name w:val="Part"/>` +
    `<w:category><w:name w:val="General"/><w:gallery w:val="placeholder"/></w:category><w:guid w:val="{6A9E2C40-3F1B-4C55-9D2E-7B1A0C9D4E11}"/></w:docPartPr>` +
    `<w:docPartBody><w:p><w:r><w:t>Part</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:docPartBody></w:docPart></w:docParts></w:glossaryDocument>`;
/** A reached glossary whose own sidecar holds two relationships of `kind` to two parts in its folder (s49c's shape). */
const dupInGlossaryRels = (kind: Kind) =>
    buildDocx({
        ...P,
        "word/glossary/document.xml": GLOSSARY,
        [`word/glossary/${fileOf(kind, 1)}`]: KINDS[kind].root,
        [`word/glossary/${fileOf(kind, 2)}`]: KINDS[kind].root,
        "word/glossary/_rels/document.xml.rels": relsPart(
            `${relationship("rId1", kind, fileOf(kind, 1))}${relationship("rId2", kind, fileOf(kind, 2))}`,
        ),
        [SIDECAR]: appendRels(P[SIDECAR]!, relationship("rIdG", "glossaryDocument", "glossary/document.xml")),
        [CT]: overrides(
            P[CT]!,
            ["word/glossary/document.xml", `${WML}.document.glossary+xml`],
            [`word/glossary/${fileOf(kind, 1)}`, KINDS[kind].ct],

const chunks: Record<string, Array<[string, string, () => Promise<Uint8Array>]>> = {
    s50a: [
        ["s50a-control-minimal", "control", control],
        [

const chunk = process.env.CHUNK ?? "";

for (const [name, issue, make] of specimens) {
    const bytes = await make();
    const file = `${name}.docx`;
    writeFileSync(path.join(dir, file), bytes);
    const sha256 = createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
    const verdict = async (profile: "word-valid" | "strict") => {
        try {
            const r = await validate(path.join(dir, file), { profile });
            return {
                valid: r.valid,
                errors: [...new Set(r.issues.filter((x) => x.severity === "error").map((x) => `${x.code}@${x.path ?? "-"}`))],
            };
        } catch (error) {
            return { valid: null, errors: [`threw:${(error as Error).name}:${(error as Error).message.slice(0, 80)}`] };
        }
    };
    const row = {
        name,
        issue,
        file,
        sha256,
        calibration: name.includes("calibration"),
        wordValid: await verdict("word-valid"),
        strict: await verdict("strict"),
    };
    appendFileSync(path.join(dir, "..", "specimens.jsonl"), JSON.stringify(row) + "\n");
    console.log(
        `built ${file} ${sha256.slice(0, 16)} word-valid=${row.wordValid.valid} ${row.wordValid.errors.join(",")} strict=${row.strict.valid} ${row.strict.errors.join(",")}`,
    );
}

`compare.py`:

```python
"""Join both passes of the session-50 chunks: log verdicts, table verdicts, validator verdicts, hashes."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path("/Users/arthrod/temp/T/docx-validate/.scratch/word-probes")
CHUNKS = ("s50a", "s50b", "s50c", "s50d")
TO_MANIFEST = {"clean-open": "clean-open", "repair-warning": "unreadable-content-warning", "open-error": "open-error"}
REJECTIONS = {"repair-warning", "open-error"}
rows = []
for label in CHUNKS:
    specs = {json.loads(l)["file"]: json.loads(l) for l in (ROOT / label / "specimens.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()}
    passes = []
    for run in (ROOT / label, ROOT / label / "pass2"):
        for name, spec in specs.items():
            digest = hashlib.sha256((run / "src" / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            assert digest == spec["sha256"], f"{run}/{name}: {digest} != {spec['sha256']}"
        passes.append({json.loads(l)["file"]: json.loads(l) for l in (run / "logcheck.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()})
    assert set(passes[0]) == set(passes[1]) == set(specs), label
    for name, spec in specs.items():
        p1, p2 = passes[0][name], passes[1][name]
        readings = [p1["logVerdict"], p1["outcomesVerdict"], p2["logVerdict"], p2["outcomesVerdict"]]
        agreed = len(set(readings)) == 1 and not p1["conflict"] and not p2["conflict"]
        outcome = TO_MANIFEST.get(readings[0]) if agreed else "unknown"
        all_rejected = all(r in REJECTIONS for r in readings)
        all_clean = all(r == "clean-open" for r in readings)
        rows.append({"chunk": label, "file": name, "sha256": spec["sha256"], "readings": readings, "agreed": agreed,
                     "outcome": outcome, "everyReadingRejects": all_rejected, "everyReadingClean": all_clean,
                     "wordValid": spec["wordValid"]["valid"], "control": "control-minimal" in spec["name"],
                     "validatorMatchesWord": (all_rejected and spec["wordValid"]["valid"] is False) or (all_clean and spec["wordValid"]["valid"] is True)})
(ROOT / "s50/results.json").write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=2) + "\n")
for r in rows:
    print(f"{r['chunk']} {r['file']:<58} {r['sha256'][:16]} outcome={r['outcome']:<27} word-valid={r['wordValid']!s:<5} match={r['validatorMatchesWord']}")
print("agreed:", sum(r["agreed"] for r in rows), "/", len(rows), "| validator matches Word:", sum(r["validatorMatchesWord"] for r in rows), "/", len(rows))
```

`section.py`:

`````python
"""Render the session-50 parts of docs/plans/evidence/word-probes-2026-10-24.md into s50/section.md.

Reads the chunk's specimens.jsonl (validator columns at 01e4e684, written by the builder), both runs'
logcheck.jsonl and pdf/manifest.jsonl, and s50/results.json from compare.py.
"""
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path("/Users/arthrod/temp/T/docx-validate/.scratch/word-probes")
CHUNKS = ("s50a", "s50b", "s50c", "s50d")
results = {(r["chunk"], r["file"]): r for r in json.loads((ROOT / "s50/results.json").read_text())}


def cell(v):
    return "valid" if v["valid"] else "invalid: " + ", ".join(f"`{e.split('@')[0]}`" for e in v["errors"])


def run_at(run, file):
    for line in (run / "pdf/manifest.jsonl").read_text().splitlines():
        row = json.loads(line)
        if row["original_filename"] == file:
            return datetime.fromisoformat(row["run_at"]).astimezone(timezone.utc)
    raise KeyError(file)


def word_cell(check):
    log, table = check["logVerdict"], check["outcomesVerdict"]
    return log if log == table else f"log: {log}; table: {table}"


rows, raw, starts, ends = [], [], [], []
for label in CHUNKS:
    specs = [json.loads(l) for l in (ROOT / label / "specimens.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
    runs = [ROOT / label, ROOT / label / "pass2"]
    checks = [{json.loads(l)["file"]: json.loads(l) for l in (r / "logcheck.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()} for r in runs]
    for s in specs:
        times = [run_at(r, s["file"]) for r in runs]
        starts.append(times[0])
        ends.append(times[1])
        result = results[(label, s["file"])]
        shape = s["issue"].replace("|", "\\|")
        rows.append(
            f"| `{label}` | {times[0]:%H:%M:%S}Z, {times[1]:%H:%M:%S}Z | `{s['name']}` | {shape} | `{s['sha256'][:16]}` | "
            f"{word_cell(checks[0][s['file']])} | {word_cell(checks[1][s['file']])} | {result['outcome']} | {cell(s['wordValid'])} | {cell(s['strict'])} |"
        )
        for n, (r, c, t) in enumerate(zip(runs, checks, times), start=1):
            row = c[s["file"]]
            raw.append(json.dumps({"run": label, "pass": n, "name": s["name"], "sha256": s["sha256"],
                                   "observedAt": t.isoformat(), "staged": row["staged"], "logVerdict": row["logVerdict"],
                                   "tableVerdict": row["outcomesVerdict"], "pdf": row["pdf"], "evidence": row["evidence"]}, ensure_ascii=False))

out = [

### Session 51: 11:55Z–11:57Z on 2026-10-26, validator columns at e762ffb5

The scope of `word-part-reference-relationship` (layer 147, [#705](https://github.com/jandira-tech/docx-validate/issues/705)), which walks the parts whose name looks like a story instead of the parts Word reads; the shapes are the review of layers 147–150's findings 1–4 ([#726](https://github.com/jandira-tech/docx-validate/issues/726)). The chunk ran twice, as two separate driver runs of byte-identical copies, and each run's rows were read twice: from its own Word log (session 41's `logcheck.py`) and by `wordpdf_outcomes.py`. Outcome is the manifest spelling when both runs and both readings agree, and `unknown` otherwise; all 8 rows agree. The two times in Observed are the ends of the first and second runs. Shape is the builder's description of the specimen.

Word-valid rejects only `word/header1.xml`: the other two are false negatives.

Word-valid rejects all three through `word-part-reference-relationship`: false positives.

```ts
// Session 51 (2026-10-26): the scope of layer 147's `word-part-reference-relationship` (#705), which walks the parts
// whose NAME looks like a story (`ctx.storyParts()`), not the parts Word reads. The review of layers 147–150 (findings
// 1–4) built these shapes; session 15 (an unreferenced malformed header opens clean) and session 35 (an unreached
// glossary is not read) predict the clean ones, but no session showed Word a chart reference in such a part.
// - an unused header (related, named by no `w:headerReference`) holding a `c:chart r:id` that names an image
//   relationship, with its sidecar and with none;
// - the main document stored as `word/main.xml` holding the same reference;
// - a glossary document no relationship reaches holding the same reference;
// - a header the body references, stored as `word/headerFirst.xml`, holding the same reference, beside the same
//   header stored as `word/header1.xml` (the calibration: session 46 refused the shape in the main document).
// Run from a worktree root as a copy: BUILD_DIR=<chunk>/src CHUNK=s51a pnpm exec tsx s51builder.tmp.mts
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { appendFileSync, mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { MINIMAL_PARTS, buildDocx } from "./tests/support/minimal-docx";
import { validate } from "./src/scripts/office/validate";

const W = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main";
const R = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships";
const C = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/chart";
const A = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main";
const WP = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/wordprocessingDrawing";
const WML = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml";
const CT = "[Content_Types].xml";
const MAIN = "word/document.xml";
const SIDECAR = "word/_rels/document.xml.rels";
const P = MINIMAL_PARTS as Record<string, string>;
const XML_DECL = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n`;
const PNG = Uint8Array.from(
    Buffer.from("iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8z8BQDwAEhQGAhKmMIQAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==", "base64"),
);
const DRAWING_NS = `xmlns:wp="${WP}" xmlns:a="${A}" xmlns:c="${C}" xmlns:r="${R}"`;

const replaceOnce = (text: string, from: string, to: string) => {
    if (text.split(from).length !== 2) throw new Error(`expected exactly one ${from}`);
    return text.replace(from, to);
};
const relationship = (id: string, segment: string, target: string) =>
    `<Relationship Id="${id}" Type="${R}/${segment}" Target="${target}"/>`;
const relsPart = (body: string) =>
    `${XML_DECL}<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">${body}</Relationships>`;
const appendRels = (rels: string, extra: string) => replaceOnce(rels, "</Relationships>", `${extra}</Relationships>`);
/** The minimal content types plus a `png` Default and the given Overrides. */
const types = (...overrides: Array<[string, string]>) =>
    replaceOnce(
        replaceOnce(P[CT]!, '<Default Extension="rels"', '<Default Extension="png" ContentType="image/png"/><Default Extension="rels"'),
        "</Types>",
        `${overrides.map(([part, type]) => `<Override PartName="/${part}" ContentType="${type}"/>`).join("")}</Types>`,
    );
/** A paragraph holding a chart drawing whose `c:chart r:id` is `id` (the review's CHART_DRAWING). */
const chartParagraph = (id: string) =>
    '<w:p><w:r><w:drawing><wp:inline distT="0" distB="0" distL="0" distR="0"><wp:extent cx="5486400" cy="3200400"/>' +
    `<wp:effectExtent l="0" t="0" r="0" b="0"/><wp:docPr id="1" name="Chart 1"/><wp:cNvGraphicFramePr/><a:graphic><a:graphicData uri="${C}">` +
    `<c:chart r:id="${id}"/></a:graphicData></a:graphic></wp:inline></w:drawing></w:r></w:p>`;
const header = () => `${XML_DECL}<w:hdr xmlns:w="${W}" ${DRAWING_NS}>${chartParagraph("rId1")}</w:hdr>`;
/** A story part's sidecar whose rId1 is an image relationship to the PNG. */
const imageSidecar = () => relsPart(relationship("rId1", "image", "media/image1.png"));
const control = () => buildDocx({ ...P });

/** An unused header: related as rIdH by the main document, named by no `w:headerReference`. */
const unusedHeader = (withSidecar: boolean) =>
    buildDocx({
        ...P,
        "word/media/image1.png": PNG,
        "word/header1.xml": header(),
        ...(withSidecar ? { "word/_rels/header1.xml.rels": imageSidecar() } : {}),
        [SIDECAR]: appendRels(P[SIDECAR]!, relationship("rIdH", "header", "header1.xml")),
        [CT]: types(["word/header1.xml", `${WML}.header+xml`]),
    });
/** A header the body references through `w:headerReference r:id="rIdH"`, stored as `word/<file>`. */
const referencedHeader = (file: string) =>
    buildDocx({
        ...P,
        "word/media/image1.png": PNG,
        [`word/${file}`]: header(),
        [`word/_rels/${file}.rels`]: imageSidecar(),
        [MAIN]: replaceOnce(
            replaceOnce(P[MAIN]!, `xmlns:w="${W}"`, `xmlns:w="${W}" xmlns:r="${R}"`),
            "<w:sectPr>",
            `<w:sectPr><w:headerReference w:type="default" r:id="rIdH"/>`,
        ),
        [SIDECAR]: appendRels(P[SIDECAR]!, relationship("rIdH", "header", file)),
        [CT]: types([`word/${file}`, `${WML}.header+xml`]),
    });
/** The main document stored as `word/main.xml`, its body holding a chart whose `c:chart r:id` names an image relationship. */
const renamedMain = () => {
    const parts: Record<string, string | Uint8Array> = {
        ...P,
        "word/media/image1.png": PNG,
        "word/main.xml": replaceOnce(
            replaceOnce(P[MAIN]!, `xmlns:w="${W}"`, `xmlns:w="${W}" ${DRAWING_NS}`),
            "<w:sectPr>",
            `${chartParagraph("rIdI")}<w:sectPr>`,
        ),
        "word/_rels/main.xml.rels": appendRels(P[SIDECAR]!, relationship("rIdI", "image", "media/image1.png")),
        "_rels/.rels": replaceOnce(P["_rels/.rels"]!, 'Target="word/document.xml"', 'Target="word/main.xml"'),
        [CT]: replaceOnce(types(), '<Override PartName="/word/document.xml"', '<Override PartName="/word/main.xml"'),
    };
    delete parts[MAIN];
    delete parts[SIDECAR];
    return buildDocx(parts);
};
/** A glossary document no relationship reaches, its part body holding the same chart reference. */
const unreachedGlossary = () =>
    buildDocx({
        ...P,
        "word/media/image1.png": PNG,
        "word/glossary/document.xml":
            `${XML_DECL}<w:glossaryDocument xmlns:w="${W}" ${DRAWING_NS}><w:docParts><w:docPart><w:docPartPr><w:name w:val="Part"/>` +
            `<w:category><w:name w:val="General"/><w:gallery w:val="placeholder"/></w:category><w:guid w:val="{6A9E2C40-3F1B-4C55-9D2E-7B1A0C9D4E11}"/></w:docPartPr>` +
            `<w:docPartBody>${chartParagraph("rId1")}</w:docPartBody></w:docPart></w:docParts></w:glossaryDocument>`,
        "word/glossary/_rels/document.xml.rels": relsPart(relationship("rId1", "image", "../media/image1.png")),
        [CT]: types(["word/glossary/document.xml", `${WML}.document.glossary+xml`]),
    });

const chunks: Record<string, Array<[string, string, () => Promise<Uint8Array>]>> = {
    s51a: [
        ["s51a-control-minimal", "control", control],
        [
            "header1-referenced-chart-image-calibration",
            "calibration: a referenced word/header1.xml whose c:chart r:id names an image relationship",
            () => referencedHeader("header1.xml"),
        ],
        [
            "headerfirst-referenced-chart-image",
            "review F3: the same header stored as word/headerFirst.xml",
            () => referencedHeader("headerFirst.xml"),
        ],
        [
            "main-renamed-chart-image",
            "review F3: the main document stored as word/main.xml, its c:chart r:id naming an image relationship",
            renamedMain,
        ],
        [
            "unused-header-chart-image",
            "review F1: an unused header (related, no w:headerReference) whose c:chart r:id names an image relationship",
            () => unusedHeader(true),
        ],
        ["unused-header-chart-no-sidecar", "review F4: the unused header with no relationships part", () => unusedHeader(false)],
        [
            "unreached-glossary-chart-image",
            "review F2: a glossary no relationship reaches whose c:chart r:id names an image relationship",
            unreachedGlossary,
        ],
        ["s51a-control-minimal-end", "control", control],
    ],
};

const chunk = process.env.CHUNK ?? "";
const specimens = chunks[chunk];
if (!specimens) throw new Error(`CHUNK must be one of ${Object.keys(chunks).join(", ")}`);
const dir = process.env.BUILD_DIR;
if (!dir) throw new Error("BUILD_DIR is required");
mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
for (const [name, issue, make] of specimens) {
    const bytes = await make();
    const file = `${name}.docx`;
    writeFileSync(path.join(dir, file), bytes);
    const sha256 = createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
    const verdict = async (profile: "word-valid" | "strict") => {
        try {
            const r = await validate(path.join(dir, file), { profile });
            return {
                valid: r.valid,
                errors: [...new Set(r.issues.filter((x) => x.severity === "error").map((x) => `${x.code}@${x.path ?? "-"}`))],
            };
        } catch (error) {
            return { valid: null, errors: [`threw:${(error as Error).name}:${(error as Error).message.slice(0, 80)}`] };
        }
    };
    const row = {
        name,
        issue,
        file,
        sha256,
        calibration: name.includes("calibration"),
        wordValid: await verdict("word-valid"),
        strict: await verdict("strict"),
    };
    appendFileSync(path.join(dir, "..", "specimens.jsonl"), JSON.stringify(row) + "\n");
    console.log(
        `built ${file} ${sha256.slice(0, 16)} word-valid=${row.wordValid.valid} ${row.wordValid.errors.join(",")} strict=${row.strict.valid} ${row.strict.errors.join(",")}`,
    );
}

"""Join both passes of the session-51 chunk: log verdicts, table verdicts, validator verdicts, hashes."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path("/Users/arthrod/temp/T/docx-validate/.scratch/word-probes")
CHUNKS = ("s51a",)
TO_MANIFEST = {"clean-open": "clean-open", "repair-warning": "unreadable-content-warning", "open-error": "open-error"}
REJECTIONS = {"repair-warning", "open-error"}
rows = []
for label in CHUNKS:
    specs = {json.loads(l)["file"]: json.loads(l) for l in (ROOT / label / "specimens.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()}
    passes = []
    for run in (ROOT / label, ROOT / label / "pass2"):
        for name, spec in specs.items():
            digest = hashlib.sha256((run / "src" / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            assert digest == spec["sha256"], f"{run}/{name}: {digest} != {spec['sha256']}"
        passes.append({json.loads(l)["file"]: json.loads(l) for l in (run / "logcheck.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()})
    assert set(passes[0]) == set(passes[1]) == set(specs), label
    for name, spec in specs.items():
        p1, p2 = passes[0][name], passes[1][name]
        readings = [p1["logVerdict"], p1["outcomesVerdict"], p2["logVerdict"], p2["outcomesVerdict"]]
        agreed = len(set(readings)) == 1 and not p1["conflict"] and not p2["conflict"]
        outcome = TO_MANIFEST.get(readings[0]) if agreed else "unknown"
        all_rejected = all(r in REJECTIONS for r in readings)
        all_clean = all(r == "clean-open" for r in readings)
        rows.append({"chunk": label, "file": name, "sha256": spec["sha256"], "readings": readings, "agreed": agreed,
                     "outcome": outcome, "everyReadingRejects": all_rejected, "everyReadingClean": all_clean,
                     "wordValid": spec["wordValid"]["valid"], "control": "control-minimal" in spec["name"],
                     "validatorMatchesWord": (all_rejected and spec["wordValid"]["valid"] is False) or (all_clean and spec["wordValid"]["valid"] is True)})
(ROOT / "s51/results.json").write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=2) + "\n")
for r in rows:
    print(f"{r['chunk']} {r['file']:<58} {r['sha256'][:16]} outcome={r['outcome']:<27} word-valid={r['wordValid']!s:<5} match={r['validatorMatchesWord']}")
print("agreed:", sum(r["agreed"] for r in rows), "/", len(rows), "| validator matches Word:", sum(r["validatorMatchesWord"] for r in rows), "/", len(rows))

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

def cell(v):
    return "valid" if v["valid"] else "invalid: " + ", ".join(f"`{e.split('@')[0]}`" for e in v["errors"])


def run_at(run, file):
    for line in (run / "pdf/manifest.jsonl").read_text().splitlines():
        row = json.loads(line)
        if row["original_filename"] == file:
            return datetime.fromisoformat(row["run_at"]).astimezone(timezone.utc)
    raise KeyError(file)


def word_cell(check):
    log, table = check["logVerdict"], check["outcomesVerdict"]
    return log if log == table else f"log: {log}; table: {table}"


rows, raw, starts, ends = [], [], [], []
for label in CHUNKS:
    specs = [json.loads(l) for l in (ROOT / label / "specimens.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
    runs = [ROOT / label, ROOT / label / "pass2"]
    checks = [{json.loads(l)["file"]: json.loads(l) for l in (r / "logcheck.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()} for r in runs]
    for s in specs:
        times = [run_at(r, s["file"]) for r in runs]
        starts.append(times[0])
        ends.append(times[1])
        result = results[(label, s["file"])]
        shape = s["issue"].replace("|", "\\|")

            f"{word_cell(checks[0][s['file']])} | {word_cell(checks[1][s['file']])} | {result['outcome']} | {cell(s['wordValid'])} | {cell(s['strict'])} |"
        )
        for n, (r, c, t) in enumerate(zip(runs, checks, times), start=1):
            row = c[s["file"]]
            raw.append(json.dumps({"run": label, "pass": n, "name": s["name"], "sha256": s["sha256"],
                                   "observedAt": t.isoformat(), "staged": row["staged"], "logVerdict": row["logVerdict"],
                                   "tableVerdict": row["outcomesVerdict"], "pdf": row["pdf"], "evidence": row["evidence"]}, ensure_ascii=False))

out = [
    f"### Session 51: {min(starts):%H:%M}Z–{max(ends):%H:%M}Z on 2026-10-26, validator columns at e762ffb5",
    "",
    "The scope of `word-part-reference-relationship` (layer 147, [#705](https://github.com/jandira-tech/docx-validate/issues/705)), "
    "which walks the parts whose name looks like a story instead of the parts Word reads; the shapes are the review of layers 147–150's "
    "findings 1–4 ([#726](https://github.com/jandira-tech/docx-validate/issues/726)). The chunk ran twice, as two separate driver runs "
    "of byte-identical copies, and each run's rows were read twice: from its own Word log (session 41's `logcheck.py`) and by "
    "`wordpdf_outcomes.py`. Outcome is the manifest spelling when both runs and both readings agree, and `unknown` otherwise; all 8 rows "
    "agree. The two times in Observed are the ends of the first and second runs. Shape is the builder's description of the specimen.",
    "",
    "- A header the body references, holding a chart whose `c:chart r:id` names an image relationship to a real PNG, gets the recovery "
    "offer stored as `word/header1.xml` (the calibration) and as `word/headerFirst.xml`; so does the main document stored as "
    "`word/main.xml` with the same reference. Word-valid rejects only `word/header1.xml`: the other two are false negatives.",
    "- The same header related by the main document but named by no `w:headerReference` opens clean, with its relationships part and "

    "Word-valid rejects all three through `word-part-reference-relationship`: false positives.",
    "",
    "| Run | Observed | Specimen | Shape | SHA-256 (first 16) | Word, run 1 | Word, run 2 | Outcome | word-valid at e762ffb5 | strict at e762ffb5 |",
    "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |",
    *rows,

]
for name, path, lang in (("s51builder.mts", ROOT / "s51builder.mts", "ts"), ("compare.py", ROOT / "s51/compare.py", "python"),

### Session 52: 12:04Z–12:13Z on 2026-10-26, validator columns at 01e4e684

The reference shapes layers 147–150 judge, or explain with a Word sentence, that no earlier session showed Word ([#728](https://github.com/jandira-tech/docx-validate/issues/728): the review of layers 147–150, finding 5, finding 7 and suspected 8, and the first reviewer run's empty ids, hdphoto and theme items). Each chunk ran twice, as two separate driver runs of byte-identical copies, and each run's rows were read twice: from its own Word log (session 41's `logcheck.py`) and by `wordpdf_outcomes.py`. Outcome is the manifest spelling when both runs and both readings agree, and `unknown` otherwise; all 28 rows agree. The two times in Observed are the ends of the first and second runs. Shape is the builder's description of the specimen.

- A typed reference naming a relationship of a Type it does not read gets the recovery offer for every shape tried: an `o:OLEObject r:id` naming a `diagramData` relationship, a `c:chart r:id` naming an External `hyperlink` relationship, and a `c:chart r:id` naming `…/relationships/chart/` or `…/relationships/Chart` to a real bar chart that opens clean when the same reference names `…/relationships/chart` (the calibration). Word-valid already rejects all four through `word-part-reference-relationship`.
- An `o:OLEObject r:id` naming an External `package` relationship opens clean; word-valid accepts it.
- An empty id gets the recovery offer in each typed reference: `c:chart r:id=""` and `o:OLEObject r:id=""` (recovery offer), and `dgm:relIds r:dm=""` (an open error with the review's `r:dm`-only element; the recovery offer on session 46's `word-clean-strict01` SmartArt, whose `r:lo`, `r:qs` and `r:cs` stay intact). A `dgm:relIds r:dm` naming an External `diagramData` relationship gets the recovery offer in both shapes. Word-valid accepts all six: false negatives. The `r:dm`-only element is not the cause: `word-clean-strict01` with `dgm:relIds r:dm="rId35"` alone opens clean.
- A chart part with no relationships part, reached only by a Microsoft `hdphoto` relationship that a picture's `a:blip r:embed` names, opens clean, as do the same chart reached only by an image relationship that a `w:name r:id` names or that a VML `v:imagedata r:id` inside a selected `mc:Fallback` names. Word-valid accepts all three.
- A `…/relationships/custom/theme` relationship beside the real theme relationship opens clean, as does one theme; two real theme relationships get the recovery offer. Word-valid agrees on all three: the theme rule's exact-Type count (layer 149) now has its Word row.

// Session 52 (2026-10-26): the shapes #728 asks Word about — reference shapes layers 147–150 judge, or explain with a
// Word sentence, that no session showed Word (the review of layers 147–150: finding 5, finding 7, suspected 8, and
// the first reviewer run's empty ids, hdphoto and theme items).
// - s52a: a typed reference naming a relationship Word was never shown under it (A1–A4), the exact-Type chart
//   calibration, and an External `package` relationship an `o:OLEObject` names (B1);
// - s52b: an External `diagramData` relationship `dgm:relIds r:dm` names (B2), empty ids (C1–C3), an `hdphoto` reach
//   a picture's `a:blip r:embed` names (D1), and an image reach a `w:name r:id` names (E1);
// - s52c: an image reach a VML picture inside a selected `mc:Fallback` names (E2), and theme duplicates counted by
//   exact Type (F1, with one theme and two real themes as calibrations).
// - s52d: s52b's `dgm:relIds` carried only `r:dm` (the review's shape), which the schema refuses on its own, so Word's
//   refusal of B2 and C3 was confounded. s52d asks again on session 46's word-clean-strict01 SmartArt, whose
//   `dgm:relIds` names all four parts: unmodified, with `r:dm=""`, with `rId35` made External, and with `r:dm` alone.
// Run from a worktree root as a copy: BUILD_DIR=<chunk>/src CHUNK=s52a pnpm exec tsx s52builder.tmp.mts
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { appendFileSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import JSZip from "jszip";
import { barChartXml, CHART_CONTENT_TYPE, PICTURE_DRAWING, reachedChartSpecimenParts } from "./tests/support/chart-specimens";
import { MINIMAL_PARTS, buildDocx } from "./tests/support/minimal-docx";
import { validate } from "./src/scripts/office/validate";

const R = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships";
const C = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/chart";
const A = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main";
const WP = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/wordprocessingDrawing";
const DGM = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/diagram";
const O = "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office";
const HDPHOTO = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/2007/relationships/hdphoto";
const THEME_CT = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.theme+xml";
const CT = "[Content_Types].xml";
const MAIN = "word/document.xml";
const SIDECAR = "word/_rels/document.xml.rels";
const CHART = "word/charts/chart1.xml";
const P = MINIMAL_PARTS as Record<string, string>;
const PNG = Uint8Array.from(
    Buffer.from("iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8z8BQDwAEhQGAhKmMIQAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==", "base64"),
);
const DRAWING_NS = `xmlns:wp="${WP}" xmlns:a="${A}" xmlns:c="${C}" xmlns:dgm="${DGM}" xmlns:o="${O}" xmlns:r="${R}"`;

const replaceOnce = (text: string, from: string, to: string) => {
    if (text.split(from).length !== 2) throw new Error(`expected exactly one ${from}`);
    return text.replace(from, to);
};
const relationship = (id: string, type: string, target: string, external = false) =>
    `<Relationship Id="${id}" Type="${type}" Target="${target}"${external ? ' TargetMode="External"' : ""}/>`;
const appendRels = (rels: string, extra: string) => replaceOnce(rels, "</Relationships>", `${extra}</Relationships>`);
const withTypes = (types: string, defaults: Array<[string, string]>, overrides: Array<[string, string]>) =>
    replaceOnce(
        replaceOnce(
            types,
            '<Default Extension="rels"',
            `${defaults.map(([ext, type]) => `<Default Extension="${ext}" ContentType="${type}"/>`).join("")}<Default Extension="rels"`,
        ),
        "</Types>",
        `${overrides.map(([part, type]) => `<Override PartName="/${part}" ContentType="${type}"/>`).join("")}</Types>`,
    );

/** The review's drawings (`review-147-150/specimens.ts`), each in its own paragraph. */
const chartDrawing = (id: string) =>
    '<w:p><w:r><w:drawing><wp:inline distT="0" distB="0" distL="0" distR="0"><wp:extent cx="5486400" cy="3200400"/>' +
    `<wp:effectExtent l="0" t="0" r="0" b="0"/><wp:docPr id="1" name="Chart 1"/><wp:cNvGraphicFramePr/><a:graphic><a:graphicData uri="${C}">` +
    `<c:chart r:id="${id}"/></a:graphicData></a:graphic></wp:inline></w:drawing></w:r></w:p>`;
const diagramDrawing = (id: string) =>
    '<w:p><w:r><w:drawing><wp:inline distT="0" distB="0" distL="0" distR="0"><wp:extent cx="952500" cy="952500"/>' +
    `<wp:effectExtent l="0" t="0" r="0" b="0"/><wp:docPr id="1" name="Diagram 1"/><a:graphic><a:graphicData uri="${DGM}">` +
    `<dgm:relIds r:dm="${id}"/></a:graphicData></a:graphic></wp:inline></w:drawing></w:r></w:p>`;
const oleObject = (id: string) =>
    '<w:p><w:r><w:object><o:OLEObject Type="Embed" ProgID="Package" ShapeID="_x0000_i1025" DrawAspect="Icon" ObjectID="_1" ' +
    `r:id="${id}"/></w:object></w:r></w:p>`;
/** The minimal package plus a PNG, `body` before the main document's `w:sectPr`, `relationships` on its sidecar. */
const withBody = (body: string, relationships: string[], extra: Record<string, string> = {}, overrides: Array<[string, string]> = []) =>
    buildDocx({
        ...P,
        "word/media/image1.png": PNG,
        ...extra,
        [MAIN]: replaceOnce(replaceOnce(P[MAIN]!, "<w:document ", `<w:document ${DRAWING_NS} `), "<w:sectPr>", `${body}<w:sectPr>`),
        [SIDECAR]: appendRels(P[SIDECAR]!, relationships.join("")),
        [CT]: withTypes(P[CT]!, [["png", "image/png"]], overrides),
    });
/** A clustered bar chart (no `c:externalData`, so no sidecar) at word/charts/chart1.xml that `c:chart r:id="rId9"` names as `type`. */
const barChartNamedAs = (type: string) =>
    withBody(chartDrawing("rId9"), [relationship("rId9", type, "charts/chart1.xml")], { [CHART]: barChartXml(false) }, [
        [CHART, CHART_CONTENT_TYPE],
    ]);

const W14_PARAGRAPH = '<w:p w14:paraId="00000002" w14:textId="00000002">';
const VML_PICTURE =
    `${W14_PARAGRAPH}<w:r><w:pict><v:shape xmlns:v="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:vml" xmlns:o="${O}" id="s1" style="width:10pt;height:10pt">` +
    '<v:imagedata r:id="rId8" o:title=""/></v:shape></w:pict></w:r></w:p>';
const NAME_REFERENCE = `${W14_PARAGRAPH}<w:name r:id="rId8"/><w:r><w:t>x</w:t></w:r></w:p>`;
/** The review's attack150 reach: the bare chart (dangling `c:externalData`, no sidecar) reached only as `type` `rId8`. */
const reach = (type: string, drawing: string) => buildDocx(reachedChartSpecimenParts(CHART, [{ id: "rId8", type }], drawing));
const fallbackVml = () => {
    const parts = reachedChartSpecimenParts(
        CHART,
        [{ id: "rId8", type: `${R}/image` }],
        `<mc:AlternateContent><mc:Choice Requires="foo"/><mc:Fallback>${VML_PICTURE}</mc:Fallback></mc:AlternateContent>`,
    );
    parts[MAIN] = replaceOnce(parts[MAIN]!, "<w:document ", '<w:document xmlns:foo="urn:foo" ');
    return buildDocx(parts);
};

/** The theme part of the repository's duplicate-theme fixture, read once. */
let themeXml: string | undefined;
const theme = async () =>
    (themeXml ??= await (
        await JSZip.loadAsync(readFileSync("tests/fixtures/broken/package.word-duplicate-theme.docx"))
    )
        .file("word/theme/theme1.xml")!
        .async("string"));
/** The minimal package plus word/theme/theme1.xml as a real theme and, when `second` is given, word/theme/theme2.xml as `second`. */
const themes = async (second?: string) =>
    buildDocx({
        ...P,
        "word/theme/theme1.xml": await theme(),
        ...(second === undefined ? {} : { "word/theme/theme2.xml": await theme() }),
        [SIDECAR]: appendRels(
            P[SIDECAR]!,
            relationship("rIdT1", `${R}/theme`, "theme/theme1.xml") +
                (second === undefined ? "" : relationship("rIdT2", second, "theme/theme2.xml")),
        ),
        [CT]: withTypes(
            P[CT]!,
            [],
            [
                ["word/theme/theme1.xml", THEME_CT],
                ...(second === undefined ? [] : [["word/theme/theme2.xml", THEME_CT] as [string, string]]),
            ],
        ),
    });
const control = () => buildDocx({ ...P });

/** Session 46's word-clean-strict01 package with `edit` applied to its parts (part name → text). */
const STRICT01 = "tests/fixtures/working/word-clean-strict01.docx";
const strict01 = async (edit: (parts: Record<string, string | Uint8Array>, text: (name: string) => string) => void = () => {}) => {
    const zip = await JSZip.loadAsync(readFileSync(STRICT01));
    const parts: Record<string, string | Uint8Array> = {};
    for (const [name, entry] of Object.entries(zip.files)) if (!entry.dir) parts[name] = await entry.async("uint8array");
    edit(parts, (name) => Buffer.from(parts[name] as Uint8Array).toString("utf8"));
    return buildDocx(parts);
};
const RELIDS = 'r:dm="rId35" r:lo="rId36" r:qs="rId37" r:cs="rId38"';
const relIdsAs = (to: string) => strict01((parts, text) => void (parts[MAIN] = replaceOnce(text(MAIN), RELIDS, to)));
const DATA_REL =
    '<Relationship Id="rId35" Type="http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/diagramData" Target="diagrams/data1.xml"/>';
const externalData = () =>
    strict01(
        (parts, text) =>
            void (parts[SIDECAR] = replaceOnce(
                text(SIDECAR),
                DATA_REL,
                DATA_REL.replace('Target="diagrams/data1.xml"/>', 'Target="http://example.com/data1.xml" TargetMode="External"/>'),
            )),
    );

const chunks: Record<string, Array<[string, string, () => Promise<Uint8Array>]>> = {
    s52a: [

            "#728 E1: the same chart reached only by image rId8 a w:name r:id names",
            () => reach(`${R}/image`, NAME_REFERENCE),
        ],
        ["s52b-control-minimal-end", "control", control],
    ],
    s52c: [
        ["s52c-control-minimal", "control", control],
        [
            "chart-image-reach-fallback-vml-reference",
            "#728 E2: the same chart reached only by image rId8 a VML v:imagedata r:id inside a selected mc:Fallback names",
            fallbackVml,
        ],
        ["theme-one-calibration", "calibration: one real theme relationship", () => themes()],
        [
            "theme-suffix-only-beside-real",
            "#728 F1: …/relationships/custom/theme beside the real theme relationship",
            () => themes(`${R}/custom/theme`),
        ],
        ["theme-two-real-calibration", "#728 F2 calibration: two real theme relationships", () => themes(`${R}/theme`)],
        ["s52c-control-minimal-end", "control", control],
    ],
    s52d: [
        ["s52d-control-minimal", "control", control],
        ["strict01-relids-calibration", "calibration: word-clean-strict01 unmodified (its dgm:relIds names rId35–rId38)", () => strict01()],
        [
            "strict01-relids-dm-empty",
            '#728 C3 calibrated: word-clean-strict01 with r:dm="" (r:lo, r:qs, r:cs intact)',
            () => relIdsAs(RELIDS.replace('r:dm="rId35"', 'r:dm=""')),
        ],
        [
            "strict01-relids-dm-external",
            "#728 B2 calibrated: word-clean-strict01 with diagramData rId35 External (http://example.com/data1.xml)",
            externalData,
        ],
        [
            "strict01-relids-dm-only",
            'confound: word-clean-strict01 with dgm:relIds r:dm="rId35" alone (no r:lo, r:qs, r:cs)',
            () => relIdsAs('r:dm="rId35"'),
        ],
        ["s52d-control-minimal-end", "control", control],
    ],
};

const chunk = process.env.CHUNK ?? "";
const specimens = chunks[chunk];
if (!specimens) throw new Error(`CHUNK must be one of ${Object.keys(chunks).join(", ")}`);
const dir = process.env.BUILD_DIR;
if (!dir) throw new Error("BUILD_DIR is required");
mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
for (const [name, issue, make] of specimens) {
    const bytes = await make();
    const file = `${name}.docx`;
    writeFileSync(path.join(dir, file), bytes);
    const sha256 = createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
    const verdict = async (profile: "word-valid" | "strict") => {
        try {
            const r = await validate(path.join(dir, file), { profile });
            return {
                valid: r.valid,
                errors: [...new Set(r.issues.filter((x) => x.severity === "error").map((x) => `${x.code}@${x.path ?? "-"}`))],
            };
        } catch (error) {
            return { valid: null, errors: [`threw:${(error as Error).name}:${(error as Error).message.slice(0, 80)}`] };
        }
    };
    const row = {
        name,
        issue,
        file,
        sha256,
        calibration: name.includes("calibration"),
        wordValid: await verdict("word-valid"),
        strict: await verdict("strict"),
    };
    appendFileSync(path.join(dir, "..", "specimens.jsonl"), JSON.stringify(row) + "\n");
    console.log(
        `built ${file} ${sha256.slice(0, 16)} word-valid=${row.wordValid.valid} ${row.wordValid.errors.join(",")} strict=${row.strict.valid} ${row.strict.errors.join(",")}`,
    );
}

```python
"""Join both passes of the session-52 chunks: log verdicts, table verdicts, validator verdicts, hashes."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path("/Users/arthrod/temp/T/docx-validate/.scratch/word-probes")
CHUNKS = ("s52a", "s52b", "s52c", "s52d")
TO_MANIFEST = {"clean-open": "clean-open", "repair-warning": "unreadable-content-warning", "open-error": "open-error"}
REJECTIONS = {"repair-warning", "open-error"}
rows = []
for label in CHUNKS:
    specs = {json.loads(l)["file"]: json.loads(l) for l in (ROOT / label / "specimens.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()}
    passes = []
    for run in (ROOT / label, ROOT / label / "pass2"):
        for name, spec in specs.items():
            digest = hashlib.sha256((run / "src" / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            assert digest == spec["sha256"], f"{run}/{name}: {digest} != {spec['sha256']}"
        passes.append({json.loads(l)["file"]: json.loads(l) for l in (run / "logcheck.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()})
    assert set(passes[0]) == set(passes[1]) == set(specs), label
    for name, spec in specs.items():
        p1, p2 = passes[0][name], passes[1][name]
        readings = [p1["logVerdict"], p1["outcomesVerdict"], p2["logVerdict"], p2["outcomesVerdict"]]
        agreed = len(set(readings)) == 1 and not p1["conflict"] and not p2["conflict"]
        outcome = TO_MANIFEST.get(readings[0]) if agreed else "unknown"
        all_rejected = all(r in REJECTIONS for r in readings)
        all_clean = all(r == "clean-open" for r in readings)
        rows.append({"chunk": label, "file": name, "sha256": spec["sha256"], "readings": readings, "agreed": agreed,
                     "outcome": outcome, "everyReadingRejects": all_rejected, "everyReadingClean": all_clean,
                     "wordValid": spec["wordValid"]["valid"], "control": "control-minimal" in spec["name"],
                     "validatorMatchesWord": (all_rejected and spec["wordValid"]["valid"] is False) or (all_clean and spec["wordValid"]["valid"] is True)})
(ROOT / "s52/results.json").write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=2) + "\n")
for r in rows:
    print(f"{r['chunk']} {r['file']:<58} {r['sha256'][:16]} outcome={r['outcome']:<27} word-valid={r['wordValid']!s:<5} match={r['validatorMatchesWord']}")
print("agreed:", sum(r["agreed"] for r in rows), "/", len(rows), "| validator matches Word:", sum(r["validatorMatchesWord"] for r in rows), "/", len(rows))
```

"""Render the session-52 parts of docs/plans/evidence/word-probes-2026-10-24.md into s52/section.md.

Reads the chunk's specimens.jsonl (validator columns at 01e4e684, written by the builder), both runs'
logcheck.jsonl and pdf/manifest.jsonl, and s52/results.json from compare.py.
"""
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path("/Users/arthrod/temp/T/docx-validate/.scratch/word-probes")
CHUNKS = ("s52a", "s52b", "s52c", "s52d")
results = {(r["chunk"], r["file"]): r for r in json.loads((ROOT / "s52/results.json").read_text())}


def cell(v):
    return "valid" if v["valid"] else "invalid: " + ", ".join(f"`{e.split('@')[0]}`" for e in v["errors"])


def run_at(run, file):
    for line in (run / "pdf/manifest.jsonl").read_text().splitlines():
        row = json.loads(line)
        if row["original_filename"] == file:
            return datetime.fromisoformat(row["run_at"]).astimezone(timezone.utc)
    raise KeyError(file)


def word_cell(check):
    log, table = check["logVerdict"], check["outcomesVerdict"]
    return log if log == table else f"log: {log}; table: {table}"


rows, raw, starts, ends = [], [], [], []
for label in CHUNKS:
    specs = [json.loads(l) for l in (ROOT / label / "specimens.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
    runs = [ROOT / label, ROOT / label / "pass2"]
    checks = [{json.loads(l)["file"]: json.loads(l) for l in (r / "logcheck.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()} for r in runs]
    for s in specs:
        times = [run_at(r, s["file"]) for r in runs]
        starts.append(times[0])
        ends.append(times[1])
        result = results[(label, s["file"])]
        shape = s["issue"].replace("|", "\\|")
        rows.append(
            f"| `{label}` | {times[0]:%H:%M:%S}Z, {times[1]:%H:%M:%S}Z | `{s['name']}` | {shape} | `{s['sha256'][:16]}` | "
            f"{word_cell(checks[0][s['file']])} | {word_cell(checks[1][s['file']])} | {result['outcome']} | {cell(s['wordValid'])} | {cell(s['strict'])} |"
        )
        for n, (r, c, t) in enumerate(zip(runs, checks, times), start=1):
            row = c[s["file"]]
            raw.append(json.dumps({"run": label, "pass": n, "name": s["name"], "sha256": s["sha256"],
                                   "observedAt": t.isoformat(), "staged": row["staged"], "logVerdict": row["logVerdict"],
                                   "tableVerdict": row["outcomesVerdict"], "pdf": row["pdf"], "evidence": row["evidence"]}, ensure_ascii=False))

out = [
    f"### Session 52: {min(starts):%H:%M}Z–{max(ends):%H:%M}Z on 2026-10-26, validator columns at 01e4e684",

    "([#728](https://github.com/jandira-tech/docx-validate/issues/728): the review of layers 147–150, finding 5, finding 7 and suspected 8, "
    "and the first reviewer run's empty ids, hdphoto and theme items). Each chunk ran twice, as two separate driver runs of byte-identical "
    "copies, and each run's rows were read twice: from its own Word log (session 41's `logcheck.py`) and by `wordpdf_outcomes.py`. Outcome "
    "is the manifest spelling when both runs and both readings agree, and `unknown` otherwise; all 28 rows agree. The two times in Observed "
    "are the ends of the first and second runs. Shape is the builder's description of the specimen.",
    "",
    "- A typed reference naming a relationship of a Type it does not read gets the recovery offer for every shape tried: an `o:OLEObject r:id` "
    "naming a `diagramData` relationship, a `c:chart r:id` naming an External `hyperlink` relationship, and a `c:chart r:id` naming "
    "`…/relationships/chart/` or `…/relationships/Chart` to a real bar chart that opens clean when the same reference names "
    "`…/relationships/chart` (the calibration). Word-valid already rejects all four through `word-part-reference-relationship`.",
    "- An `o:OLEObject r:id` naming an External `package` relationship opens clean; word-valid accepts it.",
    "- An empty id gets the recovery offer in each typed reference: `c:chart r:id=\"\"` and `o:OLEObject r:id=\"\"` (recovery offer), "
    "and `dgm:relIds r:dm=\"\"` (an open error with the review's `r:dm`-only element; the recovery offer on session 46's "
    "`word-clean-strict01` SmartArt, whose `r:lo`, `r:qs` and `r:cs` stay intact). A `dgm:relIds r:dm` naming an External `diagramData` "

    "- A chart part with no relationships part, reached only by a Microsoft `hdphoto` relationship that a picture's `a:blip r:embed` "

    "`v:imagedata r:id` inside a selected `mc:Fallback` names. Word-valid accepts all three.",

    "Word row.",
    "",

### Session 53: 13:21Z–13:33Z on 2026-10-26, validator columns at 0b26c414

The content-type shapes the review of layers 156–160 says those layers judge, or explain with a session, that no earlier session showed Word ([#739](https://github.com/jandira-tech/docx-validate/issues/739): a second relationship to an eagerly read part; [#740](https://github.com/jandira-tech/docx-validate/issues/740): the spellings and types the recovery sentence cites a session for). Each chunk ran twice, as two separate driver runs of byte-identical copies, and each run's rows were read twice: from its own Word log (session 41's `logcheck.py`) and by `wordpdf_outcomes.py`. Outcome is the manifest spelling when both runs and both readings agree, and `unknown` otherwise; all 64 rows agree. The two times in Observed are the ends of the first and second runs. Shape is the builder's description of the specimen. The part bodies are session 47's empty roots.

- A footer relationship the body references (`w:footerReference`) whose target is the main document, the related numbering part or the styles part gets the recovery offer, typed with its own type (the calibrations) and typed with session 49's and 50's refused types alike. So does `word/styles.xml` when the main document's settings relationship also targets it, typed styles or typed settings. Word-valid accepts all eight: false negatives, and the review's shapes are refused whatever the Override says.
- `word/settings.xml`, `word/fontTable.xml` and `word/numbering.xml`, related by the main document, get the recovery offer typed `APPLICATION/OCTET-STREAM`, `application/octet-stream; charset=utf-8`, `image/png` or `application/foo+xml` (session 50 showed `application/octet-stream` only). Word-valid rejects all twelve.
- The main document gets the recovery offer typed with the theme, glossary, header, footer, footnotes, endnotes, comments, settings, fontTable or numbering content type (session 50 showed the styles type only); word-valid rejects all ten.
- A related settings part typed with the main document, numbering, header, fontTable, theme or comments type, a related numbering part typed with the main document, styles, header, fontTable or comments type, and the styles part typed with the main document, numbering, header, fontTable, theme or comments type all get the recovery offer; word-valid rejects all sixteen.
- A related numbering part whose Override has `ContentType=""` gets the recovery offer, as styles (session 49) and settings and fontTable (session 50) did. Word-valid accepts it: a false negative.
